Title: 1. Rocky
description: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a supremely rare chance to fight the world heavyweight champion in a bout in which he strives to go the distance for his self-respect.

Title: 2. A Star Is Born
description: Has-been singing idol John Norman Howard falls in love with young, up-and-coming songstress Esther Hoffman in Frank Pierson's version of the classic love story updated to the rock and roll era.

Title: 3. All the President's Men
description: "The Washington Post" reporters Bob Woodward and Carl Bernstein uncover the details of the Watergate scandal that leads to President Richard Nixon's resignation.

Title: 4. The Omen
description: An American ambassador to Britain and his wife may be raising the Antichrist.

Title: 5. King Kong
description: A petroleum exploration expedition comes to an isolated island and encounters a colossal giant gorilla.

Title: 6. Silver Streak
description: On a long-distance train trip, a man finds romance--but also finds himself in danger of being killed, or at least pushed off the train.

Title: 7. The Enforcer
description: Inspector "Dirty" Harry Callahan reluctantly teams up with rookie Inspector Kate Moore to foil a terrorist organization made up of disgruntled Vietnam veterans.

Title: 8. Silent Movie
description: A film director and his strange friends struggle to produce the first major silent feature film in forty years.

Title: 9. The Pink Panther Strikes Again
description: After spending three years in a mental hospital, former Chief Inspector Charles Dreyfus badly relapses after a visit from Clouseau. He escapes the asylum, and devises a deranged plan to kill Inspector Clouseau no matter the cost.

Title: 10. Carrie
description: A social misfit with psychic powers turns prom night into Hell on Earth.

Title: 11. The Bad News Bears
description: An aging, down-on-his-luck ex-minor leaguer coaches a team of misfits in an ultra-competitive California little league.

Title: 12. The Outlaw Josey Wales
description: Avenging his murdered family, a Missouri farmer hunts down brutal Union soldiers.

Title: 13. Taxi Driver
description: A mentally unstable veteran works as a nighttime taxi driver in New York City, where the perceived decadence and sleaze fuels his urge for violent action.

Title: 14. Freaky Friday
description: A mother and daughter find their personalities switched and have to live each other's lives on one strange Friday.

Title: 15. Network
description: A television network cynically exploits a deranged former anchor's ravings and revelations about mass media for its own profit, but finds that his message may be difficult to control.

Title: 16. Gus
description: The inept 'California Atoms,' floundering in the cellar of the National Football League, welcome the team's newest member - a mule capable of place kicking a football 100 yards with deadly accuracy.

Title: 17. Marathon Man
description: The CIA and a Nazi death-camp dentist chase a New York graduate student.

Title: 18. Lipstick
description: A top fashion model seeks justice after getting sexually assaulted by her teenage sister's obsessive music teacher.

Title: 19. The Shootist
description: A dying gunfighter spends his last days looking for a way to die with a minimum of pain and a maximum of dignity.

Title: 20. Lifeguard
description: Rick, still in his 30's, works full-time as a lifeguard on the beaches of Los Angeles. When he meets his divorced high school girlfriend and her five-year-old son after fifteen years, he considers switching to a more "serious" job.

Title: 21. That's Entertainment, Part II
description: The second installment in the "That's Entertainment" trilogy features more classic scenes from MGM's vast musical library with the addition of comedy and drama films.

Title: 22. The Big Bus
description: A nuclear-powered bus driving cross-country from New York City to Colorado is destined for disaster because of the machinations of a mysterious group allied with the oil lobby.

Title: 23. Bugsy Malone
description: The classic gangster story of Bugsy Malone told with an all-child cast. The rise of Bugsy Malone and the battle for power between gangsters Fat Sam and Dandy Dan.

Title: 24. The Tenant
description: A bachelor man rents a Parisian apartment whose previous tenant committed suicide, and slowly finds himself drawn into a rabbit hole of dangerous paranoia.

Title: 25. The Last Tycoon
description: F. Scott Fitzgerald's novel is brought to life in this story of a movie producer slowly working himself to death.

Title: 26. Mr. Klein
description: In German-occupied Paris, an immoral art dealer, Robert Klein, leads a life of luxury, until a copy of a Jewish newspaper brings him to the attention of the police, linking him with a mysterious doppelgänger. Will Mr. Klein clear his name?

Title: 27. The Man Who Fell to Earth
description: An alien must pose as a human to save his dying planet, but a woman and greed of other men create complications.

Title: 28. Pantaleon
description: The Peruvian army captain Pantaleon Pantoja, a very serious and efficient officer, is chosen to set up a special service of 'visitors' to satisfy the sexual needs of the soldiers posted on remote jungle outposts.

Title: 29. Small Change
description: The lives of a motherless boy, who is just starting to get interested in women, and his physically abused friend, who lives in poverty, are mixed with more or less innocent childhood experiences and challenges of a number of children.

Title: 30. The Innocent
description: Tullio Hermil is a chauvinist aristocrat who flaunts his mistress to his wife, but when he believes she has been unfaithful, he becomes enamored of her again.

Title: 31. Master of the Flying Guillotine
description: After his students are killed by the One Armed Boxer, a vengeful and blind Kung Fu expert travels to a village where a martial arts contest is being held and vows to behead every one armed man he comes across.

Title: 32. A Real Young Girl
description: Reluctantly, a sulky adolescent returns to her parents' house for yet another boring summer vacation, dabbling in desire and the art of desirability, eventually mixing reality with vision, caged fantasies with the fierce female sexuality.

Title: 33. Chinese Roulette
description: Both parents of a young teen who walks with crutches secretly meet their lovers, who both surprise each other at the family's country home. The daughter arrives and initiates a guessing game of "Chinese roulette."

Title: 34. Satan's Brew
description: A famous poet who hasn't written a word in two years unconsciously plagiarizes the work of Stefan George, while dealing with several mistresses, his dim-witted brother, and a murder investigation.

Title: 35. Ugly, Dirty and Bad
description: Four generations of a family live in a shantytown in the outskirts of Rome and engage in various forms of dishonesty and degeneracy.

Title: 36. The Marquise of O
description: A German Marquise has to deal with a pregnancy she cannot explain and an infatuated Russian Count.

Title: 37. Chulas Fronteras
description: "Chulas Fronteras" examines the origins and social significance of the traditional Tejano (or 'Tex-Mex') music that developed along the U.S.-Mexico border.

Title: 38. In the Realm of the Senses
description: A fictionalized retelling of the story of Sada Abe, whose affair with her master quickly turned obsessive and sadomasochistic.

Title: 39. Logan's Run
description: A police officer in the future uncovers the deadly secret behind a society that worships youth.

Title: 40. Murder by Death
description: Five famous literary detective characters and their sidekicks are invited to a bizarre mansion to solve an even stranger mystery.

Title: 41. Assault on Precinct 13
description: A highway patrol officer, two criminals, and a station secretary defend a defunct Los Angeles precinct office against a siege by a bloodthirsty street gang.

Title: 42. Harlan County U.S.A.
description: A heartbreaking record of the thirteen-month struggle between a community fighting to survive and a corporation dedicated to the bottom line.

Title: 43. The Little Girl Who Lives Down the Lane
description: A thirteen-year-old girl, who lives with her absentee father, befriends a disabled teenage amateur magician and invites him, gradually, into her tenuous struggle against a predatory local neighbor.

Title: 44. Robin and Marian
description: Robin Hood, aging none too gracefully, returns exhausted from the Crusades to woo and win Maid Marian one last time.
The epic tale of a class struggle in twentieth-century Italy as seen through the eyes of two childhood friends on opposing sides.

Title: 46. Burnt Offerings
description: A family moves into a large old mansion in the countryside which seems to have a mysterious and sinister power over its new residents.

Title: 47. The Killing of a Chinese Bookie
description: Sleazy strip club owner Cosmo Vittelli is pressured into wiping out underworld power.

Title: 48. Mikey and Nicky
description: Nicky is on the run from the mob, and he turns to old pal Mikey for help.

Title: 49. Midway
description: A dramatization of the battle that was widely heralded as a turning point of the Pacific Theatre of World War II.

Title: 50. Obsession
description: A wealthy New Orleans businessman becomes obsessed with a young woman who resembles his late wife.

Title: 51. The Town That Dreaded Sundown
description: The story of a berserk, hooded killer who terrorized the border town of Texarkana, Arkansas in 1946--leaving no fewer than five murder victims in his wake. He was never caught. Based on one of America's most baffling murder cases.

Title: 52. To the Devil a Daughter
description: An occult novelist is entrusted to protect a brainwashed teenage girl from a devil-worshipping cult masquerading as a Christian sect.

Title: 53. The Missouri Breaks
description: Tom Logan is the leader of a band of horse thieves. Montana rancher David Braxton has horses, and a daughter, worth stealing. Braxton hires infamous "regulator" Lee Clayton to hunt down and annihilate the rustlers - one at a time.

Title: 54. The Message
description: Historical fresco recounting the life and times of the Prophet Mohammed, the last of the Abrahamic religion, in the sense that, according to Islam, he completed and sealed the monotheistic revelation made to Abraham.

Title: 55. The Eagle Has Landed
description: A German plot to kidnap Prime Minister Winston Churchill unfolds at the height of World War II.

Title: 56. Eaten Alive
description: A deranged hotelier feeds unwanted guests to his pet crocodile until a desperate father's search and a terrified child force his murderous routine into chaotic collapse.

Title: 57. Who Can Kill a Child?
description: A couple of English tourists arrive on an island where all the children have gone crazy and are murdering the adults.

Title: 58. Fellini's Casanova
description: Giacomo Casanova uses his sexuality to find his place in life amid eccentric and strange characters.

Title: 59. Cría Cuervos
description: In the twilight of Francisco Franco's dictatorship, an 8-year-old orphan and her two sisters find shelter in the house of their stern aunt and try their best to acclimatize to a new reality. Can they summon up the courage to grow up?

Title: 60. Alice, Sweet Alice
description: In 1961, divorced Catholic couple Dom and Catherine Spages' life is upended when their teenage daughter Alice is suspected of her younger sister Karen's brutal murder during her First Holy Communion and a series of stabbings follow.

Title: 61. Futureworld
description: Upon attempting to divulge a diabolical plot of the futuristic theme park, Futureworld, an ex-employee is dispatched after he tips off the reporter who exposed Westworld. The reporter and his ex-co-reporter investigate the situation.

Title: 62. The House with Laughing Windows
description: An art restorer uncovers a village's macabre secret while repairing a disturbing fresco, only to find himself trapped in a web of ritualistic murder and preserved agony.

Title: 63. Femmes Fatales
description: Two men flee to the countryside to escape their sexual duties and settle for a quiet, rustic life.

Title: 64. Salon Kitty
description: After an SS officer wiretaps a brothel and replaces its prostitutes with spies to obtain blackmail on the clientele, the Madam and a vengeful young hooker seek to bring about his downfall.

Title: 65. Raid on Entebbe
description: True story of a daring Israeli commando assault on the Entebbe Airport in Uganda to free hostages of a terrorist hijacking.

Title: 66. News from Home
description: Impersonal and beautiful images of Akerman's life in New York are combined with letters from her loving but manipulative mother, read by Akerman herself.

Title: 67. Grizzly
description: An 18-foot-tall, 2,000 pound grizzly bear terrorizes a national park, leaving Chief Ranger Mike Kelly, photographer Allison Corwin, naturalist Arthur Scott, and helicopter pilot Don Stober to kill it. Meanwhile, the body count rises.

Title: 68. Sebastiane
description: Reassigned to a lowly outpost, a Roman guard's Christian beliefs clash with his gay commander's desire for closeness. Being tortured becomes pleasurable.

Title: 69. Trauma
description: A paranoid writer is unable to get started on his second novel. He hires a secretary and then his troubles really begin.

Title: 70. God Told Me To
description: A New York detective investigates a series of murders committed by random New Yorkers who claim that "God told them to."

Title: 71. The House by the Lake
description: Sleazy dentist Harry owns a house in the Ontario countryside and invites his girlfriend, model Diane, for a weekend. On their way to the house, they drive past four crazed bikers, who follow Harry and Diane there, and terrorize them.

Title: 72. Keoma
description: An ex-Union gunfighter attempts to protect his plague-ridden hometown from being overridden by his racist half-brothers and a Confederate tyrant.

Title: 73. Harem Keeper of the Oil Sheiks
description: Abducted Western women arrive at a ruthless desert palace where a sadistic warden enforces brutal control over a sex trafficking ring.

Title: 74. The Cassandra Crossing
description: Passengers on a European train have been exposed to a deadly disease. Nobody will let them off the train. So what happens next?

Title: 75. Swashbuckler
description: A pirate and a hot-tempered noblewoman join forces to protect Jamaica from a tyrant.

Title: 76. The Fifth Seal
description: In Budapest in 1944, a watchmaker, a book seller and a carpenter are drinking in a bar with the owner, when they are joined by a stranger. The watchmaker asks a hypothetical question that will change their lives.

Title: 77. The Food of the Gods
description: A group of friends travel to a remote Canadian island to hunt, only to be attacked by giant killer animals which have populated the place.

Title: 78. Kings of the Road
description: A traveling projection-equipment mechanic works in Western Germany along the East-German border, visiting worn-out theatres. He meets with a depressed young man whose marriage has just broken up, and the two decide to travel together.

Title: 79. Oxen Split Torturing
description: Two short stories set in Edo during the Shogun era. 1. During a time when Christians are persecuted vehemently, Iori falls in love with young Christian girl. When she and her family are captured during a raid, his sadistic master takes her as his personal slave to torment Iori, and tries breaking her spirit by means of rape, torture and pure sadism. After Iori refuses to participate any longer he is exiled, but vows to get her back no matter what it takes. 2. When Sutezo is forced to serve the barbarous master of a brothel in order to repay his debts, he becomes friends with a young girl named Sato in process. Together, they both escape and try to get by on scams and petty theft.

Title: 80. Car Wash
description: A comedic take on the daily life of car-wash employees, chronicling their hopes, fears, joys, dreams, and tribulations, and meeting some eccentric customers along the way.

Title: 81. The Foster Brothers
description: Saban, Ramazan and Bayram are sailors in an Ottoman Navy and Hüsamettin is their commander. Hüsamettin's aide Ramazan, Saban who is foster son of Hüsamettin's sister and Bayram who is married to Hüsamettin's niece stays at Hüsamettin's family residence.

Title: 82. The Little Mermaid
description: The little mermaid, one of the daughters of the sea king, seeing the prince on the deck of a luxurious ship, falls in love with him. But during a storm, the ship crashes against a rock. The little mermaid saves her lover from death.

Title: 83. L'Agnese va a morire
description: An old couple, Agnes and Palita, lulled by their quiet routine, seem almost unaware of the war surrounding them, but soon the conflict breaks into their lives. The Germans come to take Palita, a supporter of the Resistance, and Agnes already knows in her heart that she will never see him again.

Title: 84. The Seven-Per-Cent Solution
description: To treat his friend's cocaine induced delusions, Watson lures Sherlock Holmes to Sigmund Freud.

Title: 85. Police Python 357
description: An inspector is having a secret relationship with a woman. When she is murdered by his boss, all proof is against him.

Title: 86. Mistress
description: A common thief breaks into the home of a professional dominatrix. After he begins to help her "train" her clients, he falls in love with her.

Title: 87. The Twelve Tasks of Asterix
description: Asterix and Obelix are tasked by Julius Caesar with accomplishing twelve impossible labors to determine the fate of their indomitable Gaulish village.

Title: 88. The Inugami Family
description: When a tycoon passes away, he unexpectedly leaves the family fortune to outsider Tamayo on the condition that she marries one of the grandsons, pitting blood against blood.

Title: 89. Bobbie Jo and the Outlaw
description: Aimless country girl Bobbie Jo Baker abandons her carhop job to join Wild West outlaw wannabe Lyle Wheeler for an adventure in theft, mayhem, and murder.

Title: 90. Man on the Roof
description: When a police inspector is murdered in hospital, the investigation led by detective Martin Beck uncovers reports of police misconduct and a possible revenge motive.

Title: 91. Up!
description: A well-endowed hitchhiker arrives in a town that has been rocked by the murder of a depraved Nazi warlock and finds herself pitted against a parade of perverts and ne'er-do-wells.

Title: 92. Illustrious Corpses
description: An investigation of the judges' assassinations reveals a political background.

Title: 93. Family Plot
description: Two frauds seeking a woman's heir cross paths with another couple planning a kidnapping scheme.

Title: 94. Todo modo
description: A Jesuit cleric oversees a spiritual retreat for high-ranking members of the Christian Democratic Party, during which the participants begin to die under mysterious circumstances.

Title: 95. Pardon Mon Affaire
description: As loyal as a dove, a family man is about to tell his first lie to his wife when he falls for an enchanting woman in a billowy red dress. With a bit of help, he just might get what he wishes for; however, is love always a bed of roses?

Title: 96. Tosun Pasha
description: In a battle for the "Green Valley", long-standing Turkish rival families Seferoglu and Tellioglu compete. Daver Bey, father of the lovely Leyla, holds the key as both families pursue her hand in marriage.

Title: 97. God Speed You! Black Emperor
description: The 1970s in Japan saw the rise of motorcycle gangs, which drew the interest of the media. The movie follows a member of the "Black Emperors" gang and his interaction with his parents after he gets in trouble with the police.

Title: 98. King of the Doormen
description: A janitor/doorman and his family who came to "big city" Istanbul, with the hope to live a better life. With the different characters living in the building, the story evolves around the doorman and his tricky ways to skip work but make some extra cash on the side

Title: 99. The Wing or The Thigh?
description: A renowned food critic and restaurant guide publisher battles a fast-food tycoon in a quest to protect France's culinary heritage.

Title: 100. Voyage of the Damned
description: The tragic 1939 voyage of SS St. Louis carrying hundreds of German Jewish refugees from Nazi Germany that seemingly no nation is willing to save from certain doom.

Title: 101. Two-Minute Warning
description: A crazed sniper is set to kill spectators at an L.A. Coliseum football championship game and the police race against time to eliminate him.

Title: 102. Bound for Glory
description: The early life of Woody Guthrie as a vagabond folk singer.

Title: 103. The Gumball Rally
description: An eclectic group of people takes part in a secret, and illegal, cross country road race.

Title: 104. The Message
description: The story of prophet "Muhammad" and the delivery of the message of God "Allah."

Title: 105. Buffalo Bill and the Indians, or Sitting Bull's History Lesson
description: A cynical Buffalo Bill hires Sitting Bull to exploit him and add his credibility to the distorted view of history presented in his Wild West Show.

Title: 106. The Shaggy D.A.
description: Wilby Daniels, now all grown up and running for district attorney, finds himself once again turning into a shaggy dog at inopportune moments.

Title: 107. At the Earth's Core
description: A Victorian era scientist and his assistant take a test run in their Iron Mole drilling machine and end up in a strange underground labyrinth ruled by a species of giant telepathic bird and full of prehistoric monsters and cavemen.

Title: 108. The Margin
description: Sigismond has a relationship with his wife. On a Paris trip, he becomes obsessed with a prostitute resembling his wife. His interference with her pimp leads to a beating. Receiving news of his wife and son's death, he's devastated.

Title: 109. The Front
description: In 1953, a cashier poses as a writer for blacklisted talents to submit their work through, but the injustice around him pushes him to take a stand.

Title: 110. The Song Remains the Same
description: The pioneers of hard rock take the stage - and blow your mind. Led Zeppelin storm Madison Square Garden in this collection of footage taken from their legendary performances at the New York venue in 1973.

Title: 111. The Confessional
description: The story follows a young woman, who seeks out his church. There, she is manipulated into giving confession to Father Xavier Meldrum. Meldrum uses his status and crazed persistence to work his way into Jenny's life by any means necessary.

Title: 112. Schizo
description: A newly-married woman becomes convinced someone from her past is stalking her, but nobody believes her until the bodies start to pile up.

Title: 113. Nickelodeon
description: Buck and lawyer Leo accidentally get into movie production in the early days (1910).

Title: 114. Next Stop, Greenwich Village
description: The ups and downs of life as experienced by a group of aspiring young artists in the early Fifties New York.

Title: 115. From Noon Till Three
description: A beautiful widow profits from a fling with an outlaw.

Title: 116. Chhoti Si Baat
description: A timid suitor seeks the help of a ruthless colonel to win the woman of his dreams when a bold young man begins to pursue her in this romantic comedy.

Title: 117. Dogs
description: On the quiet campus of the remotely-located Southwestern University, something strange is happening; all of the dogs in the area, once loyal, gentle pets, are now banding together in wild, feral packs and hunting down their former masters. Could the strange transformation have anything to do with the secret government experiments being conducted in the school's physics laboratory? More importantly, can the dogs be stopped before it's too late?

Title: 118. In the Dust of the Stars
description: After landing on TEM 4 following a distress call, the crew finds Temers denying sending it. At a ruler's party, drugged food clouds their minds. Navigator Suko, alone on the ship, makes a horrific discovery.

Title: 119. J.D.'s Revenge
description: Murdered on Bourbon Street in 1942 New Orleans, a gangster returns from the dead 34 years later possessing the body of a young, black law student in his quest for revenge.

Title: 120. The Rites of May
description: A young photographer returning home for Holy Week finds himself drawn to a woman possessed by her missing sister, unraveling a dark family secret tied to his silent father.

Title: 121. Redneck Miller
description: Miller's motorcycle gets stolen, used in a drug heist. Gangster Supermac threatens him. Miller confronts drug thief rival, fights to retrieve bike. His girlfriend presumed dead reappears safe at the end.

Title: 122. Duelle
description: The Queen of the Night battles the Queen of the Sun over a magical diamond that will allow the winner to remain on Earth, specifically in modern day Paris.

Title: 123. The Bricklayers
description: A watchman is murdered at a building site. The film narrates several versions of the people involved. Based on the Vicente Lenero novel.

Title: 124. Rulers of the City
description: Two small-time hoodlums plot to get even with a treacherous boss who is intent on monopolizing all criminal activity within Rome.

Title: 125. The Chaos Class Is Waking Up
description: A kind and hardworking student joins to Hababam Sinifi (The Chaos Class) but they don't accept him as one of them and he becomes the target of all class' pranks.

Title: 126. Rattlers
description: A noted herpetologist investigating a series of fatal rattlesnake attacks on people discovers that the reptiles' brains have been affected by a mysterious nerve gas that was disposed of in the Mojave Desert by the military.

Title: 127. Excitation
description: A couple moves to a beach house, seeking escape from city life. Soon, the wife experiences disturbing visions and encounters inexplicable behavior from electronic devices, while a dark secret about the home's past lurks beneath the surface

Title: 128. Chesty: A Tribute to a Legend
description: A tribute documentary on the most decorated U.S. Marine, General Lewis B. 'Chesty' Puller.

Title: 129. Shoot
description: Two groups of armed men eye each other across a body of water. An deadly incident ensues and the first group returns to their town in fear of the consequences, which never come.They realize that far greater danger is offing.

Title: 130. Shaque
description: Vinod witnesses a killing at work and helps convict a coworker. Ten years pass until his wife gets a letter claiming Vinod wasn't honest, leading her to investigate his past.

Title: 131. Tough Cop
description: When his former partner-in-crime kidnaps a critically-ill girl to blackmail her rich father, a shabby crook teams up with a hard-nosed cop to save her.

Title: 132. The Little Mermaid
description: After her sisters wreck his ship, a mermaid saves a human prince from drowning and is helped by a traveling handyman to reach out to him on land.

Title: 133. The Marriage of Figaro
description: Two servants, Figaro and Susanna, plan to wed, but Count Almaviva wants Susanna for himself. Figaro vows revenge after learning the Count tried to seduce his bride-to-be.

Title: 134. Three Years Without God
description: A woman falls in love with a Japanese soldier during the Japanese Occupation in the Philippines; the whole town turns against her.

Title: 135. Povtornaya svadba
description: Ilya, a young man - intelligent, calm, reasonable and with a great sense of humor, who has lived more than five years in a happy marriage - meets a young girl Lida on the street and leaves the family. However, very soon he returns to his wife Nastya, but this act will not bring happiness to anyone.

Title: 136. Across the Great Divide
description: In this family classic, two orphans cross the Rocky Mountains in search of their heritage. The couple forms an uncertain alliance with a drifter and embarks on the adventure of a lifetime together.

Title: 137. Snatch
description: A kidnapped teen must write her ransom note at a remote house. When she realizes one captor has feelings for her, she uses this to survive their ordeal.

Title: 138. Barbed Wire Dolls
description: Women's prison tale, with Lina Romay as Maria who is jailed after killing her father, played by director Jess Franco, who tries to rape her. Lesbian wardens, torture, nudity, sex, insanity and conspiracy round out the formula.

Title: 139. Cannonball!
description: Racing across the country from L.A. to New York, a plethora of exotic cars carries contestants hoping to win a huge sum.

Title: 140. My Father's Wife
description: Aging wife desperately wants to sexually satisfy her husband, but he's losing interest and cheats. She seeks advice even from prostitutes but nothing helps. Tired from trying, she falls for her husband's son who reciprocates.

Title: 141. Pressure
description: A British-born younger son of an immigrant family from Trinidad finds himself adrift between two cultures.

Title: 142. Calamus
description: After Richard's sister seminary, from which he was in intimate relationships, left him and married a young man joins a commune of hippies and goes on a dangerous journey.

Title: 143. Oh, My Beautiful Stepmother
description: A father's young new wife and his troubled son, haunted by his mother's death, become lovers. Each secretly plots murder - but they have different targets in mind.

Title: 144. Squirm
description: A storm causes some power lines to break and touch the ground, drawing millions of man-eating worms out of the earth, and into town where they quickly start munching on the locals.

Title: 145. Dog Lay Afternoon
description: Jeanine is a girl who has been traumatized since childhood after having inadvertently seen her mother mate with the family's Doberman dog.

Title: 146. Gator
description: Agents force a former con man to help them nab a corrupt politician.

Title: 147. Submission
description: In wartime France, pharmacist Eliane begins an affair with her shop assistant Armand, but she soon becomes dominated by him. He demands more and more from her, humiliating her and putting her family at risk.

Title: 148. St. Ives
description: A crime novelist is hired by a shady character to negotiate the return of stolen confidential documents.

Title: 149. Stay Hungry
description: A dishonest businessman asks rich layabout Craig Blake to help him buy a gym that will be demolished for a development project in Alabama. But Craig backs out of the deal after learning that mobsters are involved in the project.

Title: 150. The First Nudie Musical
description: The heir to a bankrupt studio decides to make a daring musical to avoid demolition, agreeing to finish it in two weeks or lose ownership.

Title: 151. Rape!
description: A rape victim realizes that she enjoys sexual assault and continuously offers herself to be raped while searching for her original rapist.

Title: 152. Adventures of a Taxi Driver
description: Joe North is a cab driver in London, something that gives him many opportunities to have sex.

Title: 153. Confessions of a Driving Instructor
description: The sexual misadventures of Timothy Lea and his brother-in-law Sidney Noggett when they set up a driving-school business.

Title: 154. Hollywood Boulevard
description: A young woman arrives in Hollywood to try her luck as an actress. An incompetent agent hooks her up with a production company which specializes in low budget B-movie fair, plagued by strange deadly accidents.

Title: 155. SS Experiment Love Camp
description: Near the end of WW2, prisoners of war are used in experiments to perfect the "Aryan" race.

Title: 156. Shining Sex
description: Cynthia, an exotic dancer in a upscale resort in Southern France, is seduced by a strange couple: Alpha, a being from another dimension and her human slave, Andros.

Title: 157. Satan's Slave
description: A woman driving her parents to her uncle's house crashes near the house. Her parents die but she survives. She stays with her uncle, but it becomes clear that he and his son are planning something sinister for her.

Title: 158. The Toy
description: A poor journalist finds himself as a toy of a boss' son. Making friends with a naughty child, he tries to save him from the cruel power of his father.

Title: 160. Could We Maybe
description: A bored 15-year-old boy is taken hostage by bank robbers, along with a girl he is attracted to.

Title: 161. Emanuelle in Bangkok
description: A photojournalist chasing a royal interview crosses Bangkok and Morocco, where political danger, shifting relationships, and new encounters repeatedly pull her assignment in unexpected directions.

Title: 162. The Sailor Who Fell from Grace with the Sea
description: After his father dies, a disturbed young boy plots to take revenge on the new man in his mother's life.

Title: 163. Shout at the Devil
description: During World War I, a British aristocrat, an American entrepreneur, and the latter's attractive young daughter, set out to destroy a German battlecruiser, which is awaiting repairs in an inlet just off Zanzibar.

Title: 164. Carry on England
description: Captain S Melly has been sent to a mixed anti-aircraft battery. His mission? To instil a sense of order in the troops, who are more concerned with capturing the opposite sex than the enemy.

Title: 165. Rape
description: A psychiatrist and a reporter travel to a small Spanish village in an attempt to determine the cause of a mutual friend's mysterious illness.

Title: 166. Fantasm
description: Professor Jungenot A. Freud explores ten common female sexual fantasies as described by some of his patients.

Title: 167. Black Velvet
description: A troubled fashion model visits her wealthy friend in Egypt, where she encounters a mysterious spiritual leader and forms a bond with her friend's carefree daughter, all while struggling with her controlling husband.

Title: 168. Chess of the Wind
description: The first lady of a noble house has died and now there is conflict between the remainders for taking over her inheritance.

Title: 169. Spermula
description: A notorious secret society known as Spermula plans to return from the future and conquer Earth by neutering the male population.

Title: 170. Satan's Black Wedding
description: A man travels to another city for his sister's funeral to try to find out why she killed herself. He discovers that she is actually a vampire and returns from the dead to take revenge on her family.

Title: 171. L'adolescente
description: A Sicilian couple struggles with the wife's refusal to consummate the marriage and the husband's repeated schemes for infidelity.

Title: 172. The Pom Pom Girls
description: A group of carefree high school seniors are having the time of their lives, filled with sex, romance, and teen high jinks.

Title: 173. Drum
description: A mid-19th-century mulatto slave is torn between his success as a pit-fighter and the injustices of white society.

Title: 174. Dona Flor and Her Two Husbands
description: Dona Flor's handsome husband had been a womanizing gambler but a great lover until he drops dead in 1943. She then remarries an older pharmacist who is reliable but lacks the passion of her first husband. He returns as a ghost.

Title: 175. Blood Sucking Freaks
description: In the Theatre of the Macabre in New York, Sardu and his assistants present a show involving the torture and mutilation of young women. The audience assumes it is just an act, but the torture is real, as are the deaths.

Title: 176. Don's Party
description: On the night of the 1969 Australian election, Don holds a party in his suburban Sydney house, where his raucous, rude, embarrassing, extrovert friends discuss sex, politics, and their lives, and seduce each others wives.

Title: 177. Scorchy
description: Seattle undercover narc Jackie Parker (Stevens) is out to bust the drug smuggling ring commanded by Philip Bianco (Danova).

Title: 178. Je t'aime moi non plus
description: Petite waitress Johnny works and lives in a truck-stop, where she's lonely and longs for love. She develops a crush on garbage-truck driver Krassky, although her sleazy boss Boris warns her that he's gay.

Title: 179. Revenge of the Cheerleaders
description: Aloha High cheerleaders, who wield considerable power in their ineptly run school, struggle against real estate developers aiming to merge their school with a rival one in order to turn the location into a shopping mall.

Title: 180. Massacre at Central High
description: A high-school transfer student pushed to the edge by a trio of brutal bullies resorts to murder to reclaim the school from oppression, and later turns against the students wanting to fill the vacuum of their oppressors.

Title: 181. Island of Death
description: A couple of perverted and maniac killers get loose on a Greek island.

Title: 182. The Slipper and the Rose: The Story of Cinderella
description: A musical retelling of the classic tale of Cinderella. In the tiny kingdom of Euphrania, the King and his court are anxious to get Prince Edward wed. But Edward wants to marry for love.

Title: 183. Mother, Jugs & Speed
description: Competition between privately owned Los Angeles, California ambulance companies is played for humor.

Title: 184. Nunal sa tubig
description: Ishmael Bernal's opus recreates the quality and slow pace of life in a dying village surrounded by the sea as it is caught in the eternal cycle of love and hate, of fertility and pollution, of birth and death. A bold and successful attempt to depart from the usual commercial fare, it cryptically paints a large, bleak canvas showing rural fold and how their chances at redemption and happiness are irreversibly decimated by poverty, ignorance, neglect and the dark side of big business.

Title: 185. Black Cobra
description: Eva comes to Hong Kong. Seeing Eva perform with a snake, Judas gets interested in her. He showers her with gifts. She moves in with him and his snakes. Things get grim.

Title: 186. The Legend of the Wolf Woman
description: A woman dreams she's a werewolf and seduces men before killing them. After finding love, she seeks vengeance when her lover is murdered and she's assaulted.

Title: 187. The Ritz
description: Evading a mob contract on his life, a heterosexual man winds up hiding out at a homosexual bathhouse.

Title: 188. Street People
description: A Mafia boss is enraged when he is suspected of smuggling a heroin shipment into San Francisco. He dispatches his nephew, a hotshot Anglo-Sicilian lawyer, to identify the real culprit. The lawyer also enlists the aid of his best friend, a grand prix driver with an adventurous streak.

Title: 189. The Devil's Playground
description: Fred Schepisi's first feature is this lushly photographed period drama detailing a young boy's coming-of-age in a strict Catholic seminary in 1950s Australia.

Title: 190. Barocco
description: The story of a girl in love with a boxer. They plan to go abroad after making a lot of money by participating in an interview intended to discredit a politician at elections time. But the boxer is killed, and the murderer, little by little, falls in love with the girl who finally accepts him at the condition that he looks like the boxer he killed.

Title: 191. Things to Come
description: A dystopian Sci-Fi sex adventure.

Title: 192. The Swiss Conspiracy
description: A former U.S.Justice Department official is hired as a security consultant for a Zurich based Swiss bank when five of its clients are blackmailed.

Title: 193. Ode to Billy Joe
description: In 1950s Mississippi, teenager Bobbie Lee Hartley navigates her blossoming hormones as she is courted by Billy Joe McAllister, who is headed for tragedy.

Title: 194. Face to Face
description: Two psychiatrists have their marriage tested when one suffers a mental breakdown.

Title: 195. The Last Woman
description: Gerard and his 9-month-old son have been left by his wife for feminist reasons. The custody of his son is being threatened by his next romance.

Title: 196. Cat Murkil and the Silks
description: A street-gang member kills the gang's leader and blames it on a rival gang.

Title: 197. Kabhi Kabhie
description: Kabhi Kabhie is a movie about the love story of generations and how a chain of events brings together old lovers as friends.

Title: 198. Doomsday Machine
description: Spies discover that the Red Chinese have built a "doomsday machine" capable of destroying the surface of the Earth, and that they plan to use it within a matter of days.

Title: 199. Heart of Glass
description: The foreman of a small village glassworks dies without revealing the secret to the famous "Ruby Glass".

Title: 200. Embryo
description: A scientist (Rock Hudson) doing experiments on a human fetus discovers a method to accelerate the fetus into a mature adult in just a few days. All is not well though as the child begins to exhibit some horrific tendencies.

Title: 201. The Great Scout & Cathouse Thursday
description: Three prospectors confront their ex-partner who, 15 years earlier, ran off with all the gold from their mine and they also plan to kidnap his wife.

Title: 202. Aces High
description: In World War I, the high casualty rate amongst the rookie pilots of the Royal Flying Corps puts an enormous strain on the survivors.

Title: 203. The Devil's Men
description: Tourists are kidnapped by a devil-worshipping cult, and a priest tries desperately to save them. A gruesome tale of the devil and human sacrifice.

Title: 204. Deported Women of the SS Special Section
description: Young women in Nazi-occupied countries are packed onto a train and shipped off to a prison camp, where the sadistic commandant uses them as rewards for his lesbian guards and perverted and deviant troops.

Title: 205. The Pact
description: After being abandoned by their parents, two siblings cut themselves off from the surrounding world, and a forbidden passion arises between them.

Title: 206. The Desert of the Tartars
description: Lieutenant Giovanni Drogo is assigned to the old Bastiani border fortress where he expects an imminent attack by nomadic fearsome Tartars.

Title: 207. Intimate Games
description: A psychology teacher assigns his university class a project about personal fantasies.

Title: 208. Find the Lady
description: Three kidnapping plots simultaneously target the same young woman.

Title: 209. New Fist of Fury
description: In Japanese-occupied Taiwan, a young thief, no longer able to withstand the Japanese oppression, begins practicing kung fu to fight back against the oppressors.

Title: 210. The Next Man
description: Influential Arab diplomat becomes the target of numerous assassination attempts, after he announces his plan to make peace with Israel by letting them join the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (O.P.E.C.).

Title: 211. Insiang
description: The life of a young girl living with her mother in the slums of Manila becomes unbearable when her mother's young boyfriend moves in with them.

Title: 212. Young, Violent, Dangerous
description: Three young criminals go on a violent spree of robberies and murders, then grab a girlfriend and race toward the Swiss border with police in hot pursuit. Their brutal rampage escalates as they desperately try to escape justice.

Title: 213. Shadow of the Hawk
description: The Westernized grandson of a shaman returns to the wilderness to learn more about his Native American heritage. When he encounters powerful evil spirits, he enlists the aid of his lover and a local chief to stop the spirits.

Title: 214. Emma Mae
description: A Naive Country Girl from Mississippi comes to town with an aunt to the Big City. She takes up with her family and goes out with them and meets a guy. A loser, pill-popping head nothing who is involved with the local street gang. She Falls in love with him, but he gets arrested and goes to jail. With the $5K bail over his head, she tries a couple of ways both good and bad to raise money to get him out only to learn he really is a loser and doesn't love her. She proves for a Country Girl she is smart and resourceful.

Title: 215. The Nude Princess
description: Princess Miriam from the office of foreign ministry of the Taslamia, is sent to Milan to deal with a group of industrialists.

Title: 216. Annie
description: Annie, the mistress of a middle-aged financier, accompanies him on a trip to Hong Kong. When his business interests collapse Annie ends up destitute. She is befriended by a group of socialites and begins her rite of passage in their world.

Title: 217. Emily
description: The year is 1928 and Emily, aged seventeen, returns home from school in Switzerland. At her family estate in the English countryside, it seems everyone is trying to seduce her.

Title: 218. The Disenchantment
description: This film is a documentary about the poet 'Leopoldo Panero'. His widow and his sons talk about death in general and in this special case and also about their own family problems.

Title: 219. The Great Texas Dynamite Chase
description: Explosive drama and action when two sexy girls go on a bank robbing binge.

Title: 220. Sparkle
description: Three sisters form a singing group in 1950s Harlem, but success threatens to ruin their relationship forever.

Title: 221. The Deadly Females
description: Joan (Tracy Reed) is uncrowned queen of a generation of gorgeous women who take time off their regular day jobs to earn extra income as paid assassins.

Title: 222. Jack the Ripper
description: A serial killer whose mother was a prostitute starts killing streetwalkers as a way of paying back his mother for her abuse.

Title: 223. Hollywood High
description: Four high school girls are looking for fun. Together they frolic on the beach and cavort with their guys. In their search for a little privacy they meet up with a retired movie star whose mammoth house offers 10 private bedrooms.

Title: 224. The People Who Own the Dark
description: Rich partygoers in castle survive nuclear war. Venturing out, they find townspeople blinded. Discover sinister group called "People Who Own The Dark" exists.

Title: 225. Jackson County Jail
description: A wrongfully imprisoned young woman accused of murdering the guard who assaulted her escapes from jail and becomes a fugitive.

Title: 226. The Bingo Long Traveling All-Stars & Motor Kings
description: In the late 1930s during racial segregation, a star of the Negro League Baseball, Bingo Long, leaves his team and convinces other stars of the league to join him as free agent players touring the towns of the Midwest.

Title: 227. The Tough Ones
description: A tough, rule-bending cop pursues a maniacal, trigger-happy hunchback, a one-handed bank robber and their cronies in an effort to bring Rome's most powerful crime lord to justice.

Title: 228. Miss Nude America
description: A "Felliniesque" journey into the heart of the insatiable American dream; A slice of quintessential Americana, depicted with candor, pathos and humor.

Title: 229. The Witch Who Came from the Sea
description: A disturbed woman is haunted by memories of childhood abuse, which culminates in a murder spree.

Title: 230. The Last Victim
description: A serial rapist stalks and murders prostitutes.

Title: 231. Inhibitions
description: After years of sexual humiliation at the hands of her sadistic husband and his friends, Anna, a wealthy heiress struggles to regain her sense of identity. To that end, not only does she become ruthless in business, but also delights in sexually dominating her young secretary, Carol . When she attempts to exert her sexual power over a blythe traveler, Peter, he turns the tables on her, and she finds herself at the mercy of an unfamiliar emotion: Love.

Title: 232. Che dottoressa ragazzi!
description: A small Italian village eagerly awaits the long-overdue arrival of a doctor. Everyone expects a male, so when the sexy female doctor Sigrun S. steps out of the bus, it quickly leads to a series of slapstick events.

Title: 233. The Last Hard Men
description: In 1909 Arizona, retired lawman Sam Burgade's life is turned upside-down when his old enemy Zach Provo and six other convicts escape a chain-gang in the Yuma Territorial Prison and come gunning for him.

Title: 234. Shadows in an Empty Room
description: After his younger sister is poisoned, a tough Ottawa cop embarks on a violent journey through Montreal to find her killer, which turns into a whirlpool of revenge and betrayal.

Title: 235. Don't Bite, We Love You
description: Georges,a trucker, is the single father of young Frédéric. His job prevents him from seeing his son as often as he could, as often as he should. Brought up by his grandparents, Frédéric proves a difficult child. His only friend is his twelve-year-old neighbor Rose. One day, Georges tells his son how Agnès, his mother, abandoned him at birth. Upset by such a revelation, Frédéric decides to be revenged...

Title: 236. Incesto
description: In a country house, next to a lagoon is the couple Gustavo and Luciana, the daughter Diná and the nephew Augusto, Diná and the cousin they date, provoking jealousy in the father who justifies accusing the relationship of incestuous.

Title: 237. Private Vices, Public Virtues
description: Prince Rudolf, heir to the throne of the Austro-Hungarian Empire, deliberately provokes his father, Kaiser Franz Joseph, by his dissolute and feckless behaviour. His defiance of the Kaiser's rigid adherence to duty and the good of the empire leads to a tragic confrontation between power and hedonism at the Mayerling hunting lodge.

Title: 238. The Return of a Man Called Horse
description: The English gentleman known as Horse, returns to the American west to save his adopted Indian tribe from extinction.

Title: 239. Cloistered Nun: Runa's Confession
description: Runa, visits her sister three years after entering the convent to forgive her and help her make money. To make more money, Runa's sister wheedles gifts from various men, and Runa's sexual initiation at the convent teaches her meekness.

Title: 240. Drive-In
description: The adventures of a group of teenagers at a drive-in theatre in Texas one weekend night.

Title: 242. Dark August
description: A young man accidentally runs down a young girl with his car and has a death curse placed on him by the girl's grandfather, an occultist. He goes to a local psychic medium for help in order to escape the curse.

Title: 243. Born for Hell
description: A disturbed American war veteran arrives in Belfast during the Northern Ireland conflicts, and proceeds to terrorize a household of female nursing students.

Title: 244. Au-Pair Girl
description: Domenica, a farmer girl from Val Brembana, becomes the au pair girl of the Chiocchietti family in Rome.

Title: 245. Swedish Nympho Slaves
description: A woman kidnapped and tortured by Arminda, a brothel madame, helps authorities take down her sex palace The Pagoda. After failing for years, her testimony finally puts Arminda behind bars.

Title: 246. Mansion of the Doomed
description: A mad scientist fills his basement dungeon with victims in an insane attempt to restore his daughter's eyesight.

Title: 247. The Killer Meteors
description: Mei Xing He is a local hero, as known as "Killer Meteors", his secret weapon makes him invincible. However, when Hua Wu Bin, another powerful local character seeks his assistance, Mei Xing He will face the deadliest challenge of his life.

Title: 248. Shaolin Wooden Men
description: After witnessing the murder of his father, Little Mute trains in Shaolin Temple for revenge and is taught by various teachers, one of which is clandestine.

Title: 249. Forever Emmanuelle
description: At an institute in Manila, researchers and eco-tourists trade stories about the Mara tribe, who live on a remote island and have an annual festival of rebirth in which some of the tribe forget who they are and begin again. Laure is the daughter of the institute's director; she's a free spirit who has captured the fancy of Nicola, a European photographer. After a courtship in which the voyeuristic Nick indulges Laure's exhibitionism and sexual freedom, they set off for Mara land with Gualtier, an anthropologist, and his philosophical lover, Myrte. As they approach the Mara on the night of rebirth, who of the group will actually join the tribe to begin life anew?

Title: 250. Black Shampoo
description: A promiscuous heterosexual black hairstylist and businessman has sex with his white female customers, but when he begins a relationship with his black secretary, her white mobster ex-boyfriend resorts to violent measures to get her back.

Title: 251. The Con Artists
description: During the 1920s France, con-men Philip and Felice escape prison and join forces to swindle Philip's rich ex-wife Belle.

Title: 252. Mandinga
description: An Old South plantation owner lusts after his female slaves.

Title: 253. Velvet Smooth
description: The female head of a detective agency is hired by a crime lord to figure out who's taking his action.

Title: 254. The Black Corsair
description: Emilio Roccanera, Lord of Ventimiglia, becomes a corsair in the Spanish Main and is driven by revenge against Duke Van Guld, Governor of Maracaibo, who killed his brothers.

Title: 255. My Sister in Law
description: A magistrate is torn between her job and marrying her childhood friend, all while her rivals hire her prostitute twin sister to impersonate her and tarnish her reputation.

Title: 256. Classe mista
description: Dagmar Lassander is the stunning new teacher that every male student yearns for. Her sultry looks virtually guarantee that every boy makes it to class. School attendance is way up and no longer is staying after school considered a punishment! Equally delicious Femi Benussi plays Alfredo Pea's voluptuous aunt who is constantly being spied upon by Alfredo and his father. Featuring two of Italy's biggest and most beautiful stars, COEDS is a prime example (and an historical artifact) of the kooky Italian comedies that were popular in the 1970s.

Title: 257. Elvis! Elvis!
description: Tale of a boy, roughly eight, who experiences a number of problems due to his estranged relationship with his mother. Mom wants her little boy to be someone other than who he is; junior is stubborn, fights back.

Title: 258. The Muthers
description: A band of female pirates go undercover at a prison camp on a coffee plantation to rescue their leader's sister.

Title: 259. Sisters of Death
description: During an all-girl secret society initiation, one of the new members is killed playing Russian Roulette. Many years later the survivors are invited for a reunion to a lavish estate.

Title: 260. Madame Is Served
description: A bankrupt Italian count has just committed suicide. One of his creditors, Domenico takes over the family villa, but he allows Angela, the widowed mother, Angela's mother-in-law and the three adult sisters to stay on. He is a wealthy businessman, but also basically an uncouth peasant. Still, the dimwitted, sex-crazed sisters try to seduce both him and Daniele, his shy, virginal son. Attracted to the handsome teenager, Sultana and one of the girls allow Daniele to have his first sexual experiences.

Title: 261. El hombre de los hongos
description: In colonial Mexico, a wealthy plantation owner forces his slaves to taste some-times poisonous mushrooms, which are used in a family recipe and served at lavish parties.

Title: 262. The Blue Bird
description: Two peasant kids, Mytyl and Tyltyl, guided by Fairy Berylune, embark on a quest seeking the Blue Bird of Happiness with companions: Dog, Cat, Light, Fire, Bread, and other entities joining their journey.

Title: 263. La figliastra (Storia di corna e di passione)
description: In old Sicily, inheritance law required proof of heirs. A widower without children faces losing his fortune. He remarries Nadia, who has a daughter Daniela. When no heir arrives, his stepdaughter helps resolve the inheritance crisis.

Title: 264. Harry and Walter Go to New York
description: In 1892, two vaudevillians and petty con artists get involved, together with the most notorious bank robber, in a New York City bank heist.

Title: 265. L'affittacamere
description: Giorgia and her sister inherit a villa and decide to turn it into a pension. When the sister orders the advertising, the brochure, together with the name, Pension Paradise, leads people to believe it is a whore house.

Title: 266. The Human Tornado
description: Dolemite flees to California, where he helps Queen Bee and her Kung Fu prostitutes battle a local gangster.

Title: 267. Welcome to L.A.
description: The lives and romantic entanglements of a group of young adults who have achieved "overnight" success in Los Angeles.

Title: 268. Body of My Enemy
description: After seven years in prison for a double murder he did not commit, François Leclerc returns to his hometown to find the powerful textile magnates who framed him and carry out his calculated revenge.

Title: 269. The Clown Murders
description: Four men kidnap an old girlfriend on Halloween night as a joke to ruin a real estate deal, only to have a very real clown-masked killer stalk them seeking revenge.

Title: 270. Black Emanuelle 2
description: A clinic near Manhattan becomes a battleground of conflicting recollections as a psychologist tries to restore a traumatized model's blocked past.

Title: 271. El gordo de América
description: To celebrate his promotion, a manager decides to summon his brother, but since he kept messing up, he sends him back. His brother is not convinced and dazzled by an advertisement, he decides to set up an investigation office.

Title: 272. The Death Collector
description: Neighborhood kid goes to work for the Mafia as a debt collector.

Title: 273. Misty
description: Misty arrives in a small town to look for her mother who abandoned her 22 years ago. She stays with a bisexual artist and her friends and models for her. Meanwhile, a Christian woman with a secret tries to save her perverted niece.

Title: 274. Drive in Massacre
description: Two police detectives try to catch a serial killer who is stalking a rural California drive-in theater, randomly killing people with a sword.

Title: 275. Eat My Dust
description: Darlene's into going fast and Hoover's into Darlene, but when they both get into a red-hot race car, the reckless fun accelerates into a trunkful of hot pursuits.

Title: 276. Allegro non troppo
description: The film is a parody of Disney's Fantasia, though possibly more of a challenge to Fantasia than parody status would imply.

Title: 277. Live Like a Cop, Die Like a Man
description: Fred and Tony are members of an elite 'special squad' of police in Rome, Italy, who are licenced-to-kill, undercover cops who thrive on living dangerously.

Title: 278. The Inheritance
description: Rome, 1880. Gregorio has decided to close the family business. Then he tells his children that they will have to fend for themselves, but his beautiful, calculating, ambitious young daughter-in-law, will do anything for the inheritance.

Title: 279. Black and White in Color
description: During World War I, French colonists lost in African desert decide to attack their German neighbors.

Title: 280. My Father's Private Secretary
description: Ponziani Armando, the owner of a thriving chemical industry, lives in a beautiful villa on Lake Como with his wife and his son Franco Ersilia.

Title: 281. Queen Kong
description: Luce Habit and her female film crew set foot on the African tropical island of Lazonga where female natives idolize a huge female ape named Queen Kong. The ape immediately fancies Ray Fay, the film company's hunky male love interest.

Title: 282. Heartworn Highways
description: The best music and the best whiskey come from the same part of the country.

Title: 283. Mad Dog Morgan
description: The true story of Irish outlaw Daniel Morgan, who is wanted, dead or alive, in Australia during the 1850s.

Title: 284. Crash!
description: After a woman is nearly killed in a car accident, a doctor investigates the collision, which points toward revenge, destruction, and occult.

Title: 285. Killer Force
description: A five-man team of professionals undertake a daring robbery at a diamond mine.

Title: 286. Vigilante Force
description: After oil is found in a small town and the local factory is shut down, violent crime skyrockets. A young man has had enough and calls in his older brother, a cynical Vietnam vet, who cleans the streets but then tries to take over the town.

Title: 287. Beatriz
description: A friar seeks refuge in Beatriz's farmhouse, a girl everyone calls remarkable. Suddenly, Beatriz feels a being inside her, and everyone blames the friar.

Title: 288. The Hunter Will Get You
description: L'Alpagueur is a free-lance spy from the French secret agency. He's put on the investigation about L'epervier, a serial-killer who employs young boys to help him robbing banks before killing them.

Title: 289. Marie, the Doll
description: 17-year-old orphan Marie, with stunted maturity, meets affluent doll collector Claude. Unaware of his unhealthy obsession, she agrees to visit his doll collection. Despite her naivety, they marry, foreshadowing a disturbing dynamic.

Title: 290. The Duchess and the Dirtwater Fox
description: A female hustler is chasing after rich men, but becomes repeatedly mixed up with a suave con man and card shark through a series of misadventures before falling in love with him.

Title: 291. Slumber Party '57
description: Six schoolgirls are without parental supervision on a night their basketball team is traveling, so they organize a slumber party during which each will tell about her first sexual experience.

Title: 292. Nagin
description: While Hunting a group kills a Male Shape Shifting Snake so his lover Snake takes female form to kill each hunter one by one. One of the hunter recognizes this plot he sets out to stop Shape shifting Nagin.

Title: 293. Track of the Moon Beast
description: In New Mexico mineralogist student Paul Carlson is struck in the head by a tiny shard of a meteor causing him to unknowingly transform into a bloodthirsty reptilian creature.

Title: 294. French Undressing
description: To marry the nice teacher Yvette, Julien goes to Paris.

Title: 295. God's Gun
description: A priest and his twin brother take turns defending a small town from the vicious Clayton gang.

Title: 296. No Deposit, No Return
description: During school-break, two kids are to stay with their rich Grandpa but they would rather join their mother overseas, so, in need of plane-ticket cash, they convince two petty-criminals to fake-kidnap them for a ransom they could all share.

Title: 297. A Matter of Time
description: A simple young woman helps eccentric old countess deal with her old age and she introduces the young woman to a world of upper class society.

Title: 298. Nicole
description: Nicole, an isolated widow who lives alone in her mansion, leads a decadent and lustful life. Using her sexy body and her vast fortune to manipulate those around her, she is obsessed with controlling all the people in her life.

Title: 299. The Castaways of Turtle Island
description: Jean-Arthur and his colleague devise a plan to offer tourists extreme recreation on a deserted island with no food or shelter. A group of unsuspecting tourists ends up stranded on the island as part of their unconventional vacation package

Title: 300. Nobody's Daughter
description: An orphan girl suffers abuse from her adopting parents.

Title: 301. The Likely Lads
description: Bob and Terry find their lifelong friendship beginning to change as Terry becomes involved with a new woman. Bob is dismayed, but his wife sees the opportunity to get Terry married off and put a wedge between the friends.

Title: 302. Plot of Fear
description: An inspector infiltrates an S&M club that is connected to a series of killings distinguished by the murderer leaving a page from a German children's book at the scene of each crime.

Title: 303. Special Delivery
description: A bank robber fleeing on foot shoves a bag full of money into a mailbox in downtown L.A. Only he doesn't realize that there are two onlookers who are very interested in the bag's content.

Title: 304. Everybody Rides the Carousel
description: Show is an animated tracing of the eight stages of life, from infancy to old age, as they have been described in the works of psychoanalyst Erik H. Erikson.

Title: 305. Storm Boy
description: Mike is a lonely Australian boy living in a coastal wilderness with his reclusive father. In search of friendship he encounters an Aboriginal native loner and the two form a bond in the care of orphaned pelicans.

Title: 306. A Young Emmanuelle
description: In Genève, bookseller and publisher Axel Thorpe catches willful, rich 16-year old Sibylle Ashby shoplifting. She brags about her writing, so he challenges her to produce a book. She writes an erotic novel that Thorpe publishes anonymously, and it becomes a best seller. She also tries to capture the love of this 40-year old publisher. When he drops her for her older sister, should she seek revenge or recapture? In subplots, she gets along badly with her sister and her father, and she encourages her mother's affair with dad's sister. Axel has problems too besides the determined Sibylle: he must come to terms with the drowning death of his mother years ago.

Title: 307. Apache Woman
description: Tommy is an innocent cavalry officer who falls in love with a beautiful Apache woman (Yara Kewa) after rescuing her from a nasty gun smuggler named Honest Jeremy. When Jeremy and his gang find Tommy, gruesome violence ensues.

Title: 308. Tunnel Vision
description: A federal committee reviews the programming of an immensely popular and uncensored network from 1985, including news segments, variety shows, scripted series, public service announcements, and commercials.

Title: 309. The Summer I Turned 15
description: Peter is telling his story about a special summer, when he was invited over to summer holiday from bickering parents, to his aunt and uncle in the country. He's been there before, but this summer was quite one to remember.

Title: 310. Adalat
description: Simpleton and honest village farmer, Dharamchand alias Dharam is overjoyed when his wife, Radha gives birth to a baby boy who is christen with the name Raju. He comes to the rescue of three city-bred men, Ajit, Suresh and Sujit when they are at the mercy of a man-eating tiger; please with this they decides to offer Dharam a job in Bombay whenever he needs it. Delighted and when things are not quite rosy in the village Dharam, Radha, Raju and his sister, Laxmi decides to move to the city where-by the duo provides living quarters and appoint Dharam as the managing director of their warehouse along with a fat pay packet. Unfortunately calamity destructs when Dharam is arrested by the police for smuggling goods and is placed before the court where-by he pleads his innocence but his bosses testify against him resulting in Dharam getting 18 months imprisonment as well as an additional 6 months for contempt of court. After completing his sentence Dharam goes to his residence to find that nothing is the same anymore as his family are living as destitute while his sister Laxmi has committed suicide after being molested by Sujit. Enraged Dharam decides to seek out the three, mercilessly killing them; this behavior gets notice by the bosses of the underworld who decides to elect Dharam as their ring leader thus Dharam is able to make things right for him and his family by moving in a spacious bungalow and sending Raju to London for further education. Dharam hopes to get Raju marry to his crime-partner daughter but Raju gives his heart to Geeta Varma, the girl he reaches in London. This pits both father and son against each other and to worsen matter Ajit is still alive and plan on settling scores with Dharam once and for all.

Title: 311. Tomcats
description: When four degenerate thugs rape and murder a young waitress in part of their rape and murder spree, they are arrested, but get away with though a legal technicality. The brother of one of the rape/murder victims decides to become vigilante and kill the four degenerates by himself.

Title: 312. Creature from Black Lake
description: Two men exploring the Louisiana swamps encounter a Bigfoot-type creature.

Title: 313. The Wishing Tree
description: Marita arrives at a small village in Georgia to live with her aunt. She meets a poor young lad, Gedia, and falls in love with him. But her relatives are determined to marry the girl off to a local rich man.

Title: 314. The Hand of Death
description: A survivor of an attack on a rebel group opposing the Manchu invasion of China creates the Goose Fist fighting technique and tries for revenge on a traitor.

Title: 315. Chesty Anderson U.S. Navy
description: When one of her friends goes missing, Chesty and several fellow WAVEs go looking for her and end up in a world of senatorial corruption and Mafia intimidation.

Title: 316. Schoolgirl Report 10: Every Girl Starts Sometime
description:
This chapter in the Schoolgirl Report series revolves around a "morality class" at a girls' school, in which a number of the students' experiences factor into the lessons to be learned.

Scene 1: The teacher relates the story of Dr. Hensel, who is faced with an investigation brought on by one of his students. Susanne Hofer (Bärbel Markus) accused him of raping her during a tutoring session, but it is revealed that she was lying because he refused to have sex with her in exchange for good grades.

Scene 2: Inga (Marianne Dupont) is obsessed with sex. Seeking sexual gratification she throws herself at a series of men, eventually winding up with some bikers, who beat and rape her. Fortunately, she is rescued by a thoughtful student, who teaches her that true gratification only happens in a caring relationship. [Note: The rape scene is deleted in some versions of the film.]

Scene 3: Kati Dietz' (Yvonne Kerstin?) boyfriend wants to have sex with her, but she refuses to give in until he has seduced her youthful step-mother Angelika (Karin Lorson), whom she views as a competitor for her father's affection. Ironically, once she has succeeded in ousting her step-mother and fulfilled her carnal promise to her boyfriend, he tosses her out for being a lousy lay. Even worse, her father introduces her to her next step-mother, Paula (Carina Kreisch) -- one of her classmates!

Scene 4: Seffi (Alexandra Bogojevic) and boyfriend Karli want to "do it", but cant find anywhere to commit the deed. Karli is inspired by "The Exorcist", and convinces Seffi to act as if she is possessed while visiting her gullible aunt and uncle. He, of course, will pose as an exorcist to gain unrestricted access to her bedroom, in which the sacred ritual is performed. And he almost gets away with it!

Scene 5: Iris (Gina Janssen) is secretly making some money for her needy family as an "escort" for the wealthy Walter Harden -- until they are spotted by his nephew, Franz. After Mrs. Harden squashes the affair, Iris seduces the nosey nephew, thinking he may be her next sugar daddy. Franz, however, has other plans for Iris: enrolling her in university so that she can realize a new life as his wife when she graduates.

Title: 317. Dracula and Son
description: In the 1700s, a vampire has a son from a normal woman. The mother dies, and he spends two centuries trying to teach his meek son how to be a proper vampire but no avail. Now they have to flee from Transylvania, and they end up in France.

Title: 318. Bruce's Deadly Fingers
description: After malicious gangsters capture Bruce Wong's ex-girlfriend, a young martial artist attempts to rescue her along with the late master's book containing lethal techniques for killing with one's fingers.

Title: 319. Treasure of Matecumbe
description: In 1869 Kentucky, a young boy and his friends set out to find a treasure chest hidden by his late father in the Florida Everglades during the Civil War.

Title: 320. Dixie Dynamite
description: When their moonshiner father is killed by a corrupt deputy, two young girls decide to take over his business and get revenge on the men who had him killed.

Title: 321. The Career of a Chambermaid
description: A young chambermaid from Venice who is a fan of Italian "Telefoni bianchi" cinema of the fascist era decides to follow her dream and goes to Rome hoping to become an actress.

Title: 322. It Shouldn't Happen to a Vet
description: The adventures of a Yorkshire vet and his colleague in their everyday life.

Title: 323. The Oily Maniac
description: A frustrated young man afflicted with polio works as a paralegal for a corrupt lawyer. He gets passed onto him the technique for a strange power by a dying man, which turns him into an oil based superhero/villain.

Title: 324. Manhunt
description: A tough police detective is falsely accused of corruption, and goes on the run to clear his name. He is assisted by the beautiful daughter of a rich man.

Title: 325. School Days
description: A young substitute teacher arrives in a small town to temporarily replace an injured colleague. While staying with a local family, she navigates professional challenges and adapts to her new community.

Title: 326. The Erotic Adventures of Robinson Crusoe
description: Shipwrecked on an island full of buxom amazons R. Crusoe is trying hard to survive with honor.

Title: 328. Sky Riders
description: When an industrialist's wife and kids are kidnapped by terrorists in Greece, the woman's ex-husband comes to the rescue with a plan involving hang gliders.

Title: 329. Deep Jaws
description: A bankrupt studio schemes the government to finance a sexploitation mermaids film. Casting couches thus join the already exploitive studio. Meanwhile, the Secretary of State arranges an affair with the studio head's buxom wife Henrietta.

Title: 330. Ape
description: A newly discovered 36-foot gorilla escapes from a freighter off the coast of Korea. At the same time an American actress is filming a movie in the country. Chaos ensues as the ape kidnaps her and rampages through Seoul.

Title: 331. A Small Town in Texas
description: A crooked sheriff in a small Southern town frames an ex-convict in a drug bust and takes his girlfriend.

Title: 332. Alice in Wonderland
description: When young Alice sees a man who looks like a rabbit claiming that he is late, she follows him and stumbles into a bizarre, strange world as cryptic as the 1970s Argentina she left.

Title: 333. Mako: The Jaws of Death
description: A Vietnam veteran with a psychic connection to sharks discovers their exploitation by the local aquarium and begins an underwater reign of terror to avenge them. The movie action scenes were shot using real sharks.

Title: 334. Jumpin' at the Bedside
description: Adam Petersen is a workaholic, running an international engineering firm specializing in water treatment facilities. His lovely young wife, May, pays the price for Adam's dedication to his work - she's lonely, bored and horny! Adam has just hired Aksel Hansen as his new sales director. Aksel believes that the key to boosting their flagging business is entertaining prospective clients with wine and women - which goes against Adam's Puritanical nature. Aksel's supply of women comes from his friend Maria's "SubRosa" escort service. He gives Adam one of their brochures, which inadvertently falls into May's hands. Seeing this as an exciting alternative to her unfulfilling life as a housewife, she soon signs on with "SubRosa". Everything goes swimmingly, as May - under her working name, Eva - "escorts" a whole host of male (and female) clientele. Swimmingly, that is, until "SubRosa" is called upon to entertain a gathering of municipal leaders ... who just happen to be prospective clients of Adam Petersen's engineering firm! Complications ensue...

Title: 335. Death Rage
description: A retired hitman decides to take one last job to avenge the murder of his brother by a mafia gang. An eager would-be mobster helps him.

Title: 336. Game of Seduction
description: In 1830s France, aristocratic assassin Charles sets out to seduce the virtuous Mathilde, only to fall in love—until a jealous marquise's forged letter triggers tragedy.

Title: 337. Mado
description: Simon Léotard, 49, a real estate developer, meets Mado, 22, a prostitute, and discovers in her a secretive and endearing character.

Title: 338. Not a Pretty Picture
description: Follows main character's journey after a date rape incident, exploring circumstances, characters, and profound impact on the survivor, challenging perceptions of what constitutes rape.

Title: 339. Crypt of Dark Secrets
description: A witch resurrects a murdered Vietnam vet and takes revenge on his killers.

Title: 340. The Killer Inside Me
description: Haunted by visions from his abusive childhood, Montana deputy sheriff Lou Ford gradually exhibits the signs of a homicidal schizophrenic.

Title: 342. Spanish Fly
description: On the island of Minorca, Sir Percy de Courcy finds himself once again penniless. Since the disreputable Sir Percy isn't exactly willing to work for a living, this means he must concoct some sort of scam to maintain his lifestyle.

Title: 343. Yakuza Graveyard
description: A forceful new police precinct officer clashes with the local yakuza, contrasting his methods with his colleagues and becoming entangled with a woman connected to the criminal underworld.

Title: 344. Deathcheaters
description: Two best friends, Vietnam War veterans-turned-stuntmen, are sent as spies to the Philippines on a top secret mission for the Australian government.

Title: 345. Il medico... la studentessa
description: Claudia is a medical student who encounters many sexual complications with several men.

Title: 346. The Yum Yum Girls
description: A young woman goes to New York in order to work as model but in the big city she finds a world she did not expect.

Title: 347. Sex with a Smile
description: Five comic sketches satirizing Italian sexual mores. One follows a bodyguard's over-attentiveness; another involves a woman's ill-fated agreement to a stranger's indecent proposal

Title: 348. Won Ton Ton: The Dog Who Saved Hollywood
description: In 1924, Estie comes to Hollywood to become an actress but the dog that followed her becomes the star. Hollywood has its own rules of success.

Title: 349. The Winds of Autumn
description: In 1884, an eleven-year-old Quaker boy sets out on his own to seek revenge against a gang of outlaws who senselessly murdered his family.

Title: 350. Echoes of a Summer
description: A couple whose daughter has a life-threatening heart condition decides to make her last days of life as meaningful for her as possible by taking her to the Canadian province of Nova Scotia.

Title: 351. Black Samurai
description: Robert Sand, agent of D.R.A.G.O.N. (Defense Reserve Agency Guardian Of Nations), is playing tennis on his vacation with a beautiful black girl, when his commanding officers ask him to save a Chinese girl who happens to be Sand's girlfriend, and the daughter of a top Eastern Ambassador. The ransom for the abduction was the secret for a terrific new weapon - the freeze bomb - but the 'Warlock' behind the deed is also into the business of drug dealing and Voodoo ritual murders. The search takes him from Hong Kong to California through Miami, and plenty of action, against bad men, bad girl, and bad animals.
