Title: 352. À nous les petites Anglaises!
description: After failing their exam, Jean-Pierre and Alain are sent to England. But all they want are girls.

Title: 353. Las Poquianchis
description: Three sisters run brothels protected by the authorities, abuse and prostitute young women under the false pretense of employing them as servants.

Title: 354. Vengeance
description: Tom's parents are killed by Mexicans after their leader (Van Cleef) rapes his mother as he watched. He sets out to exact revenge and is ultimately helped by a successful gold prospector who has been robbed by the same group.

Title: 355. Laila Majnu
description: Two lovers are unable to unite as they face opposition from their families. While the boy is exiled from the town after committing a murder, the girl is married to another man.

Title: 356. Do Anjaane
description: A man (Amitabh Bachchan) is found wounded on railway tracks and when he awakens he has no memory of who he is and doesn't remember anything about his life. Six years later he is living with a wealthy couple and is now named Naresh Dutt. One day he begins to regain his memory when he watches a film and realizes that the actress in the film is related to him somehow. It is then that he discovers the actress in the film is none other than his wife Rekha Roy (Rekha). He finds out that she is now a very successful film actress changing her name to Sunita Devi and her manager is none other than Ranjeet Malik (Prem Chopra) who used to be his best friend. In flashbacks he remembers that his real name is Amit Roy and Ranjit was the one who attempted to kill him six years earlier by throwing him off the train he was traveling on with Rekha. Amit also discovers that his young son who is now 10 years old has been sent to a boarding school and sets out a plan to regain custody of his son. First however he plans on taking revenge against Ranjit. Amit comes up with a plan to re-enter Rekha and Ranjit's lives by disguising himself as a film producer. He meets with Rekha and Ranjit and offers Rekha the opportunity to act in his new film titled Do Anjaane. Rekha and Ranjit grow suspicious of Naresh Dutt as they start to realize that he bears a striking resemblance to Rekha's supposedly deceased husband Amit Roy and the storyline of his film eerily mirrors Rekha's past life. Will she discover the true identity of Naresh Dutt? and what revenge has Amit/Naresh got planned for Ranjit?

Title: 357. Sasquatch: The Legend of Bigfoot
description: Scientists mount an expedition to find a Bigfoot-type creature.

Title: 358. Kenny & Company
description: A coming-of-age story about the lives of a teenage boy and his friend as they traverse the highs and lows of boyhood in the run-up to Halloween.

Title: 359. Pure as a Lily
description: Anthony M. Wilson is an English gentleman. He has a string of restaurants in London plus a beautiful house decorated with all the trendy art he can get.

Title: 360. Memoria
description: A scientist specialising in the field of neurophysics seeks to transplant memories. With the help of his assistant, and the assistant's lover, the Professor presents his initial findings to an ethics panel, who reject his use of the drug B2 to facilitate memory transfer. But wheels are already in motion, and the test subject awakes.

Title: 361. Keep It Up Downstairs
description: When Cockshute Towers is threatened with bankruptcy, its oversexed inhabitants attempt various money-making schemes.

Title: 362. Mr. Robinson
description: A shipwreck strands a modern Italian businessman on a desert island. Like Robinson Crusoe he must find a way to return to civilization; unlike him--he's a 20th-century man, a totally different case.

Title: 363. Manthan
description: A young veterinary surgeon, Dr. Rao, who makes a visit to a village, where he intends to commence a co-operative society dairy for the betterment of the rural people.

Title: 364. The Big Racket
description: Nico Palmieri is a police inspector who battles against hoodlums frightening Rome, extorting cash from the locals.

Title: 365. Shaolin Temple
description: The Shaolin Temple begins to accept outside students seeking to learn the superior techniques of the Shaolin kung fu, amidst some bad omens foretelling the future of the Temple.

Title: 366. Gable and Lombard
description: A biography about the love affair between 1930s Hollywood superstars Clark Gable and Carole Lombard.

Title: 367. The Judge and the Assassin
description: An unstable former French Sergeant commits many atrocities. A judge considers how this case could benefit or damage his career.

Title: 368. Passion Plantation
description: In the pre-civil war American south, Emanuelle, a plantation owner's daughter, while outwardly a dainty southern belle, brutally abuses the slaves in her charge. When her fiance is bitten by a snake, he falls for Emanuelle's beautiful African-American maid who's kindness and skill saved his life. Insanely jealous, Emanuelle continues her sadistic behaviour towards her charges, and when her fiance announces he plans to wed the maid, Emanuelle "gives" her to her even more brutal hired men, and her fiance is powerless to stop them. Can Emanuelle learn an important lesson in love before it's too late for everyone?

Title: 369. Squadra antiscippo
description: A top undercover cop finds and arrests a series of purse snatchers until he discovers an American at the top of an evil ring of thieves.

Title: 370. Affæren i Mølleby
description: Mølleby's mayor in 1924 wants investors from Copenhagen to invest in a local brick production etc. His daughter wants to get married and his bookkeeper wants to publish poems with money "borrowed" from the municipality. Problems arise.

Title: 371. Under the Doctor
description: A British sex comedy about a doctor, a bevy of beautiful women and their sexual problems. Can the overworked and over-titillated doctor help his patients while resisting the urge to help himself?

Title: 372. C.B. Hustlers
description: Truckdrivers help each other avoid the police by creating roadblocks by communicating on their CB radios.

Title: 373. Midnight Party
description: A nightclub stripper hooks up with two playboys and ends up with an invitation to their midnight orgy.

Title: 374. Tanya
description: A rich girl is kidnapped by a revolutionary group, but instead of wanting to be rescued, she decides to join her captors' organization.

Title: 375. In Search of Noah's Ark
description: An investigation into the theory that Mt. Agri in Turkey is the final resting place of Noah's Ark.

Title: 376. Little Girl... Big Tease
description: Virginia, the appropriately named maiden daughter of a wealthy businessman, is kidnapped by a two men and a woman. Sixteen-year-old Virginia loses her maidenhead when she is viciously raped by the ignorant muscle-man of the outfit. She is then comforted by the woman, whom she has sex with. Losing her innocence, Virginia decides she likes it and seduces the boss of the outfit. She falls in love with the three and does not want to be given back to her Daddy after she is ransomed.

Title: 377. East End Hustle
description: Cindy, an ex-prostitute rescues Marianne, one of her pimp's potential new recruits and a deadly rivalry begins.

Title: 378. I'm Not Feeling Myself Tonight
description: Virginal nerd works at sex research institute. He invents machine emitting aphrodisiac to seduce secretary. Machine causes unintended consequences, affecting boss and campaigner. Nerd's attempts to seduce secretary fail.

Title: 379. Death Has Blue Eyes
description: Two crooks travel to Greece and get forced by circumstance into a job protecting a mysterious young woman with a strange power from resourceful enemies who supposedly want her dead.

Title: 380. Queen of the Gypsies
description: Rada, a beautiful and very proud gipsy girl is used to steal men's hearts and monk them. Zobar is a horse thief who's heart is stolen by Rada and his mind is bewitched. He is ready to give up his freedom but not his pride.

Title: 381. Fantozzi 2
description: The frustrating adventures of a humble employee who spends all of his time fulfilling his bosses' wishes and desires.

Title: 382. Leadbelly
description: Biography of the legendary folksinger, Huddie Ledbetter, master of the 12-string guitar and long-time convict on Texas and Louisiana chain gangs.

Title: 383. Survive!
description: A Uruguayan rugby team crashes in the Andes Mountains and has to survive the extremely cold temperatures and rough climate. As some of the people die, the survivors are forced to make a terrible decision between starvation and cannibalism.

Title: 384. The Rat Savior
description: A poor writer discovers that a species of rats has banded together to impersonate humans and supplant them unnoticed, in a manner reminiscent of the transformations in Eugene Ionesco's Rhinoceros, or the covert conspiracy of pod-people in The Invasion of the Body Snatchers. This film's story is based on a book by the Soviet writer Alexander Grin.

Title: 385. The Bawdy Adventures of Tom Jones
description: Tom Jones, a maid's son adopted by the nobleman she worked for, now all grown up must run away from home when he is set up by his jealous cousin. He has several adventures and women on his way to town where his possible salvation awaits.

Title: 386. Atti impuri all'italiana
description: Medical doctor Elia Bonvicini becomes the town medic of a little Tuscan town. She immediately becomes the focal point of many males suffering from the illness of sexual frustration, and has to deal with the town's male-dominated culture.

Title: 387. Soldier of Fortune
description: Medieval soldier of fortune Ettore is travelling through Europe with his partners looking for fight where they can earn some money. When they come across a Spanish castle under siege by the French army, Ettore first bides his time to determine which side is the winning one (and thus more likely to pay his fee). This is as first the French, but the treatment he receives from them is unpleasant enough to make him change his mind and turn to the Spanish side. Somehow, Ettore must rally the weakened Spanish troops to battle their enemy long enough for reinforcements to arrive.

Title: 388. The Last Round
description: A calculating southern migrant infiltrates a northern crime syndicate and systematically turns rival factions against each other to settle personal scores.

Title: 389. Sweet Revenge
description: A teenage car thief's obsessive quest to own an expensive sports car keeps her lawyer and the police working overtime.

Title: 390. New Female Prisoner Scorpion: #701
description: Nami Matsushima's sister goes missing and after getting too caught up in doing something about it, Nami is given a fifteen year sentence for a murder she didn't commit. She's sent to an all women prison where she's not exactly welcome.

Title: 391. Cattivi pensieri
description: Mario Marani is a well-respected lawyer in late 70s Milano. He and his wonderful wife Francesca have an intense high social life. But Mario has a problem. He is obsessed by bad thoughts (cattivi pensieri); he is always concerned about his wife, thinking continuously to be betrayed by her. It is a nightmare, every time Mario sees Francesca talking to one of their friends immediately starts to see her and him in an hot affair. Jealousy and suspects increase and increase, till their life cross with a young man hidden inside their flat.

Title: 392. Bloodlust
description: A deaf and dumb accountant suffers from a psychic trauma in his childhood. He is collecting puppets and mutilates female bodies in the mortuary. After his secret love died by an accident he starts to kill.

Title: 393. La cameriera nera
description: Major Galeazzo, Chancellor Enea, the goalkeeper Placido, journalist Antenor and others living in a building of the city. All are drawn to the morbid fascination of Mariolina, exuberant waitress Venetian. But soon Aminta, maid of color, dispossess irreparably.

Title: 394. Violent Naples
description: An uncompromising cop gets transferred to Naples on account of this city's atrocious crime levels. His no-hold-barred police methods are considered to be the perfect antidote.

Title: 395. Dr. Black, Mr. Hyde
description: When a Black doctor develops a serum that is supposed to regenerate dying liver cells and tests it on himself, it accidentally turns him into an albino monster with a lust for murdering prostitutes, pimps and drug dealers.

Title: 396. Deseo
description: A teenage boy's parents hire a private tutor to help him pass his courses. As the classes progress, the teacher feels more and more the attraction that exerts on the boy.

Title: 397. The Magic Blade
description: Two rival swordsmen, the heroic Fu Hung Hsieh and the wealthy Yen Nan-Fei, must team up to prevent the legendary Peacock Dart from falling into the hands of Mr. Yu and his evil criminal underworld. Traps, poisons, and double-crossings are everywhere in this spooky swordplay thriller from the Shaw Bros. Studio.

Title: 398. The Battle of Chile: Part II
description: Filmmaker Patricio Guzmán tracks the deterioration of Salvador Allende's position following the attempted coup d'état of 29 June 1973, and analyzes the 10 weeks before Augusto Pinochet's CIA-backed seizure of power.

Title: 399. Hera Pheri
description: Two friends Ajay and Vijay gets separated from each other when they discover secrets about their past in their own ways.

Title: 400. Caddie
description: Sydney, Australia in the mid-1920's. Proud and classy Caddie Marsh is forced to get a job as a barmaid and raise two children on her own after her rich cad husband walks out on her. Despite numerous hardships such as the Great Depression, Caddie still manages to catch the eye of smooth dandy Ted and strikes up a romantic relationship with dashing Greek gentleman Peter.

Title: 401. Goodnight, Ladies and Gentlemen
description: An episodic satire of the social and politic status of Italy in the 1970s through the programming of a television channel.

Title: 402. The Student Body
description: Three female inmates are offered early parole if they become test subjects for a college class. The class professor, Dr. Blalock, is secretly testing an experimental drug on the girls on behalf of a pharmaceutical company.

Title: 403. Challenge of the Masters
description: An impetuous young man, whose father refuses to teach him kung fu, is accepted under his father's martial arts master's tutelage. He goes through harsh training for over two years, and comes out of it as a wise kung fu master.

Title: 404. Le jardin des supplices
description: In the 1930's a young doctor is forced to flee from Paris because he is involved in a drug scandal. On his passage to China he meets a beautiful, eccentric woman. After their arrival in China, she introduces him into a circle of decadent Europeans which created a torture garden for their amusement. While the bored imperial upper class is torturing the locals the revolution is rising.

Title: 405. It Could Happen to You
description: An educational film about the perils associated with sexually transmitted diseases (STDs). The drama is interspersed with scenes of a medical adviser directly addressing the camera giving advice and information about STDs.

Title: 406. Return of the Prodigal Son
description: Freed after spending 12 years in jail, a man's homecoming turns into a dark affair as his disillusion clashes with his family expectations.

Title: 407. The Sell-Out
description: While vacationing in Lebanon, a former secret agent finds he has been marked for assassination.

Title: 408. Barefoot Gen
description: The story of Gen Nakaoka and his family, who lived in Hiroshima at the time it was atom-bombed, and their struggles and trials amidst the nuclear holocaust.

Title: 409. The Littlest Horse Thieves
description: Three young chldren set about rescuing unwanted pit ponies that are due to be sent to a slaughter house.

Title: 410. Trackdown
description: A Montana rancher (Jim Mitchum) comes to Los Angeles, searching for his runaway sister (Karen Lamm), who has become entangled in a world of crime, drugs, and prostitution.

Title: 411. North Sea Is Dead Sea
description: Two 14-year-old boys try to escape their oppressive home in a working-class suburb of Hamburg, first by taking a homemade raft and later a stolen sailboat down the Elbe towards the open sea.

Title: 412. Moving Violation
description: A young drifter (Stephen McHattie) and his newly acquired girlfriend (Kay Lenz) witness a corrupt local Sheriff kill his deputy, soon becoming the prime suspects they set off across country to evade capture.

Title: 413. In Hell
description: An actress of political torture movies made by her husband has to finish his latest film and arrange a screening for distributors while the husband, who is also secretly an anarchist revolutionary, is away for some resistance operation.

Title: 414. The Twist
description: Bored aristocratic Parisian couples begin affairs with each other which only brings trouble.

Title: 415. I Will... I Will... For Now
description: A divorced couple tries reconciliation through a legal contract instead of remarriage, while the husband's lawyer, who loves the ex-wife, plots to sabotage their reunion using a seductive neighbor.

Title: 416. El ministro y yo
description: A good-hearted clerk falls in grace to a minister who invites him to work for the government. His ethics on job alienates him from colleagues while making efforts to return speech to a girl.

Title: 417. Colt 38 Special Squad
description: A police commissioner forms a secret motorized brigade in order to fight a dangerous terrorist who is depositing bombs throughout the city of Turin.

Title: 418. El apando
description: In Mexico city, the most infamous jail "Lecumberri" three prisoners make a plan to introduce drugs.

Title: 419. Death Machines
description: An evil Oriental Dragon Lady injects three martial arts fighters with a serum that turns them into zombie-like assassins, and she sends them out against her enemies.

Title: 420. Nashville Girl
description: Young girl finds the rough road to musical stardom.

Title: 421. Goodbye, Norma Jean
description: Aspiring actress Norma Jean Baker lives in squalor in the early '40s as she works at the munitions plant and dreams of being a movie star. Abused as a child and an adult, she lacks self-confidence, but photographer Ralph Johnson takes some publicity shots and convinces her to try for her dream, and supports her as she's bounced from casting couches to sleazy photo shoots. She befriends once-powerful producer Hal James, who tries to steer her toward her dream of stardom, to where she will eventually be known as Marilyn Monroe.

Title: 422. Nick the Sting
description: Nick Hezard, a young con man, wants to avenge the death of a friend of his and organizes a swindle trying to cheat Robert Turner, an American businessman he thinks responsible for his friend's death. He succeeds in getting a hundred thousand swiss francs and uses them to carry out the second part of his plan.

Title: 423. Holiday Hookers
description: Madame is running a high-class escort--and prostitution--service. She wants to quit the business as soon as she makes enough money to make her dreams come true, but her relationship with her girls has been deteriorating.

Title: 424. The Night of the Askari
description: A colonial police officer in Rhodesia hunts down the albino terrorist who raped and murdered his fiancée.

Title: 425. Scandalo in famiglia
description: Elena loves her stepmother's brother and tries to seduce him. The feeling is mutual but she is forced to marry a nobleman. The only solution is adultery.

Title: 426. A Woman at Her Window
description: Margot Santorini is an aristocratic woman in 1936 in Greece, who amuses herself pursuing a shallow loveless affair with a nobleman, but unexpectedly falls in love with a political activist.

Title: 427. La spiaggia del desiderio
description: A shipwrecked sailor falls in love with a beautiful island woman.

Title: 428. The International Assassin
description: A cabal of international criminals plot to assassinate Queen Elizabeth II during a state visit to Hong Kong, which the police attempt to prevent whilst managing a refugee crisis.

Title: 429. Beach Guard in Winter
description: This dramatic and yet comical story sorrounds a good-hearted young man who wants to get married to a girl he loves but can't get a good job, home of his own, and both of their parents aren't helping the cause either. Story about crushed hopes and dreams of a better life that can hardly happen.

Title: 431. The Watcher in the Attic
description: When a tenant from a shabby 1920s boarding house secretly witnesses the landlady perform a truly heinous act, he is overcome with desire for her and begins plotting to kill a fellow tenant to demonstrate his love.

Title: 432. Confessions of a Lady Cop

description: A student of Bruce Lee travels to Hong Kong to search for answers regarding his masters death. He gets involved with the Hong Kong mafia and ends up having to avenge the brutal death of his girlfriend.

Title: 565. La lozana andaluza
description: In 16th-century Rome, Rampín, a sympathetic and shameless rogue, exploits his deceptive arts. He lives with his aunt, Napolitana, a gossiper dedicated to the same trades as his nephew. With the arrival of a beautiful Andalusian, Lozana, fortune enters the house by making her the most beautiful courtesan of Rome. Lozana and Rampín reach an agreement: he will be at her service, taking many lovers at home, and she will give him the best, what others will never have. But one day, don Sancho, a handsome Spaniard, falls in love with her.

Title: 566. The Memory of Justice
description: Explores the subject of atrocities during wartime, especially during World War II and the Vietnam War.

Title: 567. La ciutat cremada
description: The story takes place in Barcelona following the disaster in Cuba until the Tragic Week, approximately from 1899 until 1909, by means of events which befall a family in that city.

Title: 568. The Shadow Line
description: From Joseph Conrad's great novel comes the story of a young seaman trying to helm a damaged boat to Singapore and dealing with many unfortunate events. While on command of the situation, he also devotes himself to help his failing crew and some of the boat's many passengers, some of them who are in poor health conditions.

Title: 569. Love at First Sight
description: A young woman named Shirley befriends a lonely blind man named Roy. Together, they find love - even though Shirley's father opposes the relationship.

Title: 570. Harmonium
description: A child princess gets a harmonium from her father. Through fate and manager she is orphan, then widow and penniless. The harmonium, sold, changed hand and bringing ill-luck wherever it went. Will they ever meet? Under what circumstances?

Title: 571. The Clown
description: Hans Schnier has earned his living as a clown, though he is in fact a very covert sort of social critic. After enduring a difficult childhood in Bonn during the Second World War, including his mother's fanatic Nazism.

Title: 572. Alex & the Gypsy
description: Alexander Main, a bail bondsman, falls for one of his "customers", a pretty gypsy girl, Maritza, who's been accused of murder.

Title: 573. The Good and the Bad
description: The story takes place in France from 1935 to 1945 where a gang use a Citroën car to hold up stores and banks.

Title: 574. Train in the Snow
description: One class of school children from a small village make the trip to Zagreb. Teacher gets sick and the class is forced to go home without him. During their journey the train gets stuck in a snowstorm.

Title: 575. Buffalo Rider
description: This film, follows the adventures of a guy ON A buffalo.

Title: 576. Central Bazaar
description: A group of strangers explore their fantasies over a period of five days.

Title: 577. Crimson, the Color of Blood
description: A mad doctor performs a head transplant on an injured criminal, which results in him being even more dangerous and murderous than before.

Title: 578. Una bella governante di colore
description: Nicola Salluzzi is the owner of an insecticide company and his teenage son Simone has the habit of sleeping with his female employees.

Title: 579. San Babila: 8 P.M.
description: A group of neo-nazi youngsters, usual customers of a bar in the famous Milan public square, lives through one day of madness passing between assaults, rapes and homicides. Thanks to the testimony of one of the victims the four criminals will be assured to the Police justice

Title: 580. Call Girl (La vida privada de una señorita bien)
description: A girl enters the service of a brothel owner who initiates her into the trade.

Title: 581. Sturmtruppen
description: A slapstick comedy about soldiers in the Nazi army during World War II.

Title: 582. The Children of Violent Rome
description: A story of a modern day neo-Nazi youth gang that meets in a place decorated with swastikas and a poster of the "Führer". The members of this gang are all bored teenagers from rich families.

Title: 583. La querida
description: Manuela Silva is an attractive Andalusian young woman who left her village ready to succeed as a singer in Madrid. By chance, she meets Eduardo, a neighboring composer who gives Manuela her first opportunity in the world of entertainment, and between them is born a romance. But, little by little, as Manuela gets successes she will meet other men, richer and more powerful than Eduardo, who will end up turning her into a luxury mistress.

Title: 584. Unmade Beds
description: Photographer Rico fantasizes himself a 1960s Paris gangster. An outsider using his camera like a gun, he searches for reality to fulfill his dreams until falling in love disrupts the delicate balance of his imagined world.

Title: 586. Devil's Express
description: A tough black martial artist cop takes on warring street gangs and an evil demon that haunts the New York City subways.

Title: 587. The .44 Specialist
description: A murderous drug dealer breaks his partner out of police custody. An undercover cop is assigned to track down the two killers and bring them in.

Title: 588. Bruce Lee Fights Back from the Grave
description: A kung Fu expert travels to America to take out a gang of mysterious villains responsible for the murder of his best friend.

Title: 589. Lost in the Wild
description: A twelve year old boy and a common criminal are being transported in the same ship from England to Australia in the last century. When the ship wrecked they happen to be the only survivors of the catastrophe. Now they have to get along with each other and finally become friends.

Title: 590. Eliza Fraser
description: An old captain & his young wife share a lot of adventures after they're shipwrecked and captured by Aborigines on an island near Australia.

Title: 591. Blind Rage
description: CIA Agent Jesse Crowder tries to close the case of five blind bank robbers in the Philippines.

Title: 592. Merakli Köfteci
description: Zuhtu, a nosy hawker who sells meatballs, one night finds a young girl escaping from her cruel relatives. He intends to help the girl but this costs him too much.

Title: 593. The Last Concert
description: Love story of a young woman Stella who is dying of leukemia. A man who is mistakenly taken as a family member at a hospital and is informed by a doctor the diagnosis of Stella. Stella cheerfully follows the man. He is reluctant at first but after some shaky moments it develops into a relationship. The two fall in love in the short period of time left to experience.

Title: 594. The All-American Woman
description: All Jean wants is romance but all she gets is casual sex. It turns out that her stepniece Debbie has the same problem.

Title: 595. Project: Kill
description: A former government assassin flees a mind-control program in the Philippines, pursued by his ex-partner, the local police and Asian gangsters.

Title: 596. Strømer
description: Released from a mental institution, a cop returns to work where he's stored away in the fraud department. However, with the help of a tabloid reporter, he investigates an old horse race fraud case and people start dying around him.

Title: 597. The Private Eyes
description: The kingpin of the Manix Private Detective Agency and his fellow detective solve cases together.

Title: 598. Dragonfly
description: A man, recently released from a mental hospital, tries to track down his family.

Title: 599. Anatomy of a Relationship
description: A woman's feminist awakening drives a couple to a relationship crisis.

Title: 600. The Leper
description: A simple governess and a wealthy aristocrat fall madly in love with each other. However, his family are prejudiced towards her and have other plans for him.

Title: 601. Bullet
description: Plain-clothes Inspector Dharam Dev is hot on the tracks of notorious underworld don, Durgaprasad, alias "D.P." But Durgraprased is not only elusive, but shrewd and cunning as well, and spreads of web of lies and deceit, and entraps Dharam in it, and a result of which Dharam himself becomes a suspect for murder, and is arrested.

Title: 602. The Probability Factor
description: In this black comedy, Fred (Jean-Louis Trintingnant) works for an insurance company as a computer engineer. Fred is bored with enduring the trials of his shrewish wife, so, after using actuarial tables to calculate the most common means of death, he cleverly prepares the family bathroom and brings about her demise. For a while he is content with his new freedom, but then he recognizes that a friend is in a similar situation.

Title: 603. Seven Nights in Japan
description: The fictional British royal Prince George travels to Japan and falls in love with a local female tour guide named Sumi. He considers breaking the rules and staying with her there, but a Japanese gangster wants him dead.

Title: 604. Halfon Hill Doesn't Answer
description: Sergio Konstanza, in debt to Mr. Hasson, flees to join an Army reserve unit led by a Sergeant interested in one of Hasson's daughters. However, Hasson demands his older daughter marries first before allowing the younger one to wed.

Title: 605. Ebony Ivory & Jade
description: An American track team has just arrived in The Philippines for an international competition. Among the competitors are Ginger and Pam, nicknamed "Ivory" and "Ebony", who meet up with another friend, Jackie, nicknamed "Jade". After they arrive at their hotel, a gang of thugs kidnaps them, along with some other girls from the team. To get away, the trio will need to use all their fighting skills.

Title: 606. The Shaolin Avengers
description: Two young men join forces with another man to take revenge from a martial arts clan, who're allies with the Qing government, who killed their father.

Title: 607. Kjære Maren
description: Two young women arrives from the countryside to the capital around 1900, with the dreams of a new and better life.

Title: 608. The Beach Bunnies
description: A reporter for a gossip magazine stays at a beach house near that of a movie star to investigate reports that he had had a sex change operation.

Title: 609. Squadra antifurto
description: Tomas Milian as the unconventional undercover cop with a pet mouse named 'Serpico'. Still difficult for an investigation commissioner Nico Giraldi, this time struggling with a gang who commits theft in luxury apartments in Rome.

Title: 610. Angst
description: The Øyens' leave their 5 year old daughter to the babysitter, who later that night receives some mystical phone calls. The hunt has begun.

Title: 611. Nel più alto dei cieli
description: A group of pilgrims in the Vatican is trapped in an enclosed elevator. Then chaos erupts, and repressed urges come to the surface.

Title: 612. Il pomicione
description: Raffaele is a man who decides to change his life: he manages to get noticed by a beautiful girl.

Title: 613. Snake Dancer
description: Semi- biographical film about the early life of stripper Glenda Kemp.

Title: 614. Run After Me Until I Catch You
description: A misogynistic tax collector and a dog clipper shearer meet through a marriage advertisement. Both forty years old, they have little quirks they can't shake. They also have different personalities, and every time they meet, they end up arguing.

Title: 615. Tapasya
description: The oldest daughter of an old and ailing man falls in love with the doctor treating her father, but the mother of the doctor insists that the girl must leave everything she does and stay with them.

Title: 616. Taxi Love - Servizio per signora
description: During the summer, a group of taxi drivers offer tourists everything they want: the car to travel, the cicerone to illustrate monuments, plus sexual services are also included.

Title: 617. A Suit for Wedding
description: A woman orders a suit from a tailor for her young son to wear to her sister's wedding. The tailor's apprentice, together with two other teenage boys who work in the same building, devise a plan to try on the suit at night to see what it feels like. Things get a little complicated but in the morning, at the last possible minute, they manage to return the suit to its proper place.

Title: 618. Lady Moonflower
description: Kizaki kidnaps Yuriko and tortures her, taking photographs. Using the photos, he blackmails flower arrangement teacher Yumeji, Yuriko's older sister.

Title: 619. The Liberation of Cherry Janowski
description: A scientific genius invents equipment that tests the erotic levels of people. He sets out to find subjects for his experiments.

Title: 620. Zindagi
description: Raghu Shukla lives in a small town in India with his wife, Sarojini; two sons - Naresh and Ramesh, who are married to Sudha and Shobha respectively, and altogether have three children, an unmarried daughter, Seema, who is away studying in a hostel, and a nephew named Prabhu. When the time comes for Raghu to retire, his sons and daughter-in-laws are thrilled as he will get his retirement savings. But all are disappointed when Raghu pays off his debts instead and decides to live as a dependent on his sons. Naresh decides to move out to Bombay, and informs them that he can only take Sarojini with him, while Ramesh says his income can only accommodate Raghu. In this way, Raghu and Sarojini are separated. Sarojini re-locates to Bombay where she will eventually be treated as a maidservant, and live a life confined in the four walls, while Raghu will be dependent for all his needs on Ramesh and Shobha. When Seema comes for a visit, she witnesses her parents' plight and decides to take an extreme step to alleviate their sufferings - a step that will send shock waves to Ajay, her boyfriend, as well as the rest of the Shukla family.

Title: 621. Family Honour
description: The life of a poor but happy crowded family is put to a great test when the rich and spoiled Oktay enters their lives.

Title: 622. Fury of the Dragon
description: Several episodes of the 1966 TV series "The Green Hornet" edited together and released as a feature.

Title: 623. Death Journey
description: A D.A. tasks a private detective to safely transport a mob trial witness from L.A. to N.Y. but hired killers are after them.

Title: 624. Olsenbanden for full musikk
description: Valborg needs to get her son Basse married, after getting a girl pregnant, while Egon has got work for a baron. However a spook makes trouble for his planned coup against the National Theater.

Title: 625. Nine Months
description: A village-girl (Juli Kovács) arrives in the city to work in a factory. The work manager (János Bodnár) sets his eye on her, but at first the girl refuses his advance.

Title: 626. Max Havelaar
description: An idealistic Dutch colonial officer posted to Indonesia in the nineteenth century is convinced that he can make the kinds of changes that will actually help the local people of whom he is in charge.

Title: 627. Let's Make a Dirty Movie
description: A bumbling film crew attempts to make a porno movie. Unfortunately, the cast are all egomaniacs or incompetents, and the set manager is too shy to purchase any equipment from the sex shops. Nevertheless, they make do with what they have.

Title: 628. Shadow of Angels
description: Beautiful, detached, laconic, consumptive Lily Brest is a streetwalker with few clients. She loves her idle boyfriend Raoul who gambles away what little she earns. The town's power broker, called the rich Jew, discovers she is a good listener, so she's soon busy. Raoul imagines grotesque sex scenes between Lily and the Jew; he leaves her for a man. Her parents, a bitter Fascist who is a cabaret singer in drag and her wheelchair-bound mother, offer no refuge. Even though all have a philosophical bent, the other whores reject Lily because she tolerates everyone, including men. She tires of her lonely life and looks for a way out. Even that act serves the local corrupt powers.

Title: 629. No Way Back
description: Crowder is a man who will do anything, if the price is right. He is a private detective with a past in the police force. A woman comes to his office one day and asks if he will find her husband. He takes the mission, but soon he gets into a lot of trouble with some gangsters.

Title: 630. Tras-os-Montes
description: A poetic docudrama with non-linear storytelling, showing life in Portugal's Terra Fria region. Features traditional customs in rural settings. A key Portuguese New Cinema work and pioneering docudrama.

Title: 631. A Child in the Crowd
description: Abandoned by his father and ignored by his mother, Paul seeks love and affection with the soldiers and other men he meets on the streets of Paris during the German occupation.

Title: 632. San Pasquale Baylonne protettore delle donne
description: Giuseppe Cicerchia, a guy with small criminal records and a failed marriage behind him, has created fame as a healer in a small mountain village.

Title: 633. Rivals in Love
description: A maid at a seaside hotel nurses to health a man she found on the beach who has lost his memory.

Title: 634. Poliziotti violenti
description: Paratrooper officer Altieri and police commissioner Tosi investigate the case of criminals who use modern machine guns that disappeared from an army unit. The investigation leads them to a conspiracy of high military ranks.

Title: 635. Return of the Kung Fu Dragon
description: Golden City, capital of wondrous Phoenix island, is attacked by an evil despot and his sorcerer ally and conquered, with the Emperor and his three generals killed by the invaders. The young princess and the three children of the generals are hidden away from the invaders with the hope that they one day will return to avenge the deaths of their fathers and reclaim the island paradise. Almost twenty years pass and the grown children do finally return to confront the despot and the sorcerer but, will they be successful?

Title: 636. Joshua
description: A black soldier returns from fighting for the Union in the Civil War only to find out that his mother has been murdered by a gang of white thugs. He becomes a bounty hunter, determined to track down and kill the men who killed his mother.

Title: 637. Les pornocrates
description: A look behind the scenes of the French adult film industry.

Title: 639. El hombre desnudo
description: A group of outlaws attack a house, rape the mother and kill the rest of the family, but there is one survivor - a boy.

Title: 640. Yo fui violada
description: In Panamá City, a man stalks a well-to-do adolescent, without knowing that she is the daughter he procreated when he raped a woman.

Title: 641. Mustang Country
description: A rancher and former rodeo star comes across a runaway boy while he is hunting a wild stallion.

Title: 642. A Special Cop in Action
description: A crime syndicate starts a crime wave in Turin, they rob a bank, taking a hostage to get away from Police Inspector Betti and Ferrari, his partner. However, the hostage turned out to be their accomplice in disguise.

Title: 643. Bittersweet Love
description: Young married couple expecting a baby suddenly discover they are half-brother and sister.

Title: 644. Slave Wife
description: When a stuck-up and privileged lady of a wealthy family is left to fend for herself, her butler decides to teach her some overdue humility through BDSM.

Title: 645. Brotherhood of Death
description: A group of black Vietnam vets go up against the Ku Klux Klan.

Title: 646. Surreal Estate
description: An English novelist is lured, with disconcerting and disorienting results, into purchasing a crumbling mansion by what he imagines are the deliberately 'literary' ploys of its housekeeper and two mysterious, lurking women.

Title: 647. Killer Clans
description: A fearsome assassin is contracted to kill the patriarch of a large and formidable clan. Meanwhile, the benevolent clan leader's top men are attacked by a rival clan and killed. Shortly after, an internal power struggle reveals itself.

Title: 648. Vårnatt
description: It tells the story of two siblings who for the first time spend a night without their parents, and are visited by strangers who ask for room for the night.

Title: 649. Oh, Serafina!
description: Augusto Valle is a successful young industrialist who weds Palmira, the girl working in his factory, and the two have a child despite the infant's uncertain legitimacy. Scheming to control her husband's fortune, Palmira has affairs with both the mayor and the judge to have Augusto committed to a mental institution. While there, he falls in love with Serafina Vitali, a young woman who was also put away.

Title: 650. La professoressa di lingue
description: Michele, the son of a wealthy family, suffers from stuttering, and this leads him to be sent back to English and French. For the September exams, he will have to study all summer with Pamela, a sexy and beautiful teacher.

Title: 651. Forbidden Love
description: When a pretty girl suffers from a psychological crisis, her mother takes her to a psychiatrist. As the doctor discovers that the girl's condition is the result of her stepfather's attempts to rape her, she decides to take revenge on him and kill him for what he did to her.

Title: 652. Chalte Chalte
description: Geeta and Anil meet, gets acquainted with each other only to fall in love; they then get married but on their wedding night Anil is killed by bandits leaving a devastated Geeta who goes unconscious for a period of 4 days after which she loses her mental balance and is confined in a mental asylum. Several years later she does manage to recover, is discharged and enter into the real world only to find that Anil is still alive, now calls himself Ravi Kapoor and is in love with a young woman named Asha. The discovery of Anil triggers Geeta and she decides to make Ravi her own; eventually she gets out of hand and is re-confined in the mental asylum. A few days later she manages to escape, enters the couple's house and when Ravi is away she decides that she will settle scores once and for all with Asha - the one she believes is out to claim her husband.

Title: 653. Batton Story
description: Femi is accused of being a prostitute and is thrown into jail with the rest of the clan. Their she befriends the prostitutes and decides to set up an organization for prostitutes' rights.

Title: 654. As Massagistas Profissionais
description: A womanizer gets a job as an instructor in a massage parlour.

Title: 655. Mauricio, mon amour
description: Due to his sex addiction, Mauricio voluntarily enters a clinic. Taking care of him is doctor Verónica, who subjects him to a treatment that annuls his excessive virility and turns him into an effeminate. In order to repair her mistake, the doctor decides to call three of Mauricio's former lovers to help him recover.

Title: 656. End Play
description: When a hitchhiker is picked up and murdered by an unseen assailant, two brothers both become suspects, all the while increasing their tensions between them as they both pursue their half-cousin, Margaret.

Title: 657. The Wild Duck
description: This tragic drama is adapted from a popular Ibsen play about the relationship between a mother, her ego-maniacal husband, and their daughter. The father never approves of anything the daughter does.

Title: 658. The Arrival of Joachim Stiller
description: Freek and Simone's lives are taken over by the bizarre character Joachim Stiller.

Title: 659. Children
description: A man with a boring lonely life remembers his childhood of bullying, Catholic school, and the death of his abusive father from illness.

Title: 660. Dance of Death
description: A woman uses her knowledge of kung fu to kill many warriors by kicking them in the ribs and head.

Title: 661. This Is How We Were Before, How Are You Doing Now?
description: Set at the turn of the 20th century during the Filipino revolution against the Spaniards and, later, the American colonizers, it follows a naive peasant through his leap of faith to become a member of an imagined community.

Title: 662. L'année sainte
description: Two bank robbers, an old and a young, escape from prison to get to the hidden loot.

Title: 663. Oss
description: De tradisjonelt fattige landene har etter en politisk omveltning stanset eksporten av råvarer. Den vestlige verden kommer i en økonomisk krise, som raskt brer seg i Norge. Arbeidledigheten øker voldsomt, og det blir vanskeligere å få tak i matvarer. Regjeringen vil ikke offisielt innrømme krisen, men frykten brer seg i befolkningen. Demonstrasjoner mellom befolkningen og politi hører med til dagens orden. Også Thomas og Vera er arbeidsløse. Den eneste veien de ser ut av uføret er å flytte ut fra byen og leie et nedlagt gårdsbruk. Omsetningen av matvarer blir forbudt. Militære styrker kommer for å beslaglegge det lille de har. Senere følger også bybefolkningen, som i panikk reiser ut på landsbygda for å sikre seg noe å spise.

Title: 664. Chi dice donna dice donna
description: Film in five episodes on the female universe. Among the women portrayed, neglected wives who become prostitutes, a worker who improvises a sexy bomb and a priestess who gives herself as wife to an emigrant.

Title: 665. Welcome to Britain
description: Featuring the voices of different generations of British immigrants themselves.

Title: 666. The New Shaolin Boxers
description: A hotheaded martial arts student is causing trouble by standing up against a local gang who's been bullying his town's folk. Their big boss shows up one day and almost kills him, so he begins learning advanced kung fu from a true master.

Title: 667. Regrouping
description: Feminist portrait of four artists in a women's group.

Title: 668. Per amore
description: A classical pianist falls in love with a friend's young daughter.

Title: 669. Meat
description: This mid 1970's documentary shows how livestock are raised, sold, and processed in the United States.

Title: 671. Bairaag
description: Thakur Chandrabhan lives a wealthy lifestyle in a small village in India. He is widowed and lives with his sister; a widowed daughter-in-law, Saraswati; and a grand-daughter, Tara, who is of marriageable age. Also living in this household is Bholanath, who is blind since birth, and helps with household chores. Tara's marriage is arranged with a young man, Pratap Singh, from a noble family, who approves of Tara, but demands a dowry of 3 Lakh Rupees. Chandrabhan does not have this much money, but Bholanath has been stashing away cash, that is guarded by a snake, and offers all of it to Pratap, who accepts it and absconds. Blind Bhola is unable to pursue him, but is instead bitten by the snake, regains his vision and sets forth to Bombay to locate Pratap. Several weeks later, Bholanath returns home, just in time to be told that he must marry Tara, as she refuses to marry anyone else. Tara notices something very odd about Bholanath as he calls her "Tara', not as "Little Mistress" as he used to; he is terrified of snakes; and seems more cultured and educated. The family decides to get the two engaged, however, the ceremony is interrupted by the arrival of the police, who have an arrest warrant for Bholanath for Theft, and Murder of a young woman named Lucy. The question remains, what was Bholanath up to in Bombay, whose money did he steal, and why did he end up killing Lucy?

Title: 672. A Labor of Love
description: Fly on the wall documentary about the making of The Last Affair (1976), which was an independent feature made in Chicago, Illinois with a stipulation mandated by its financial backers that it had to include explicit hardcore sex scenes in order to capitalize on the porno chic trend which was popular in the mid-1970's. However, the shooting of the movie doesn't go as smoothly as planned, with various unforeseen complications along the way to its completion.

Title: 673. Shao Lin Kung-Fu Mystagogue
description: The evil Ching government has taken over and is out to rid the land of the remaining Ming rebel patriots, including the still surviving Ming Prince.

Title: 674. Freewheelin'
description: Stacy Perlata and Camille Darrin share a passion for their lifestyle of skateboarding. Camille narrates the film, and the two of them travel to various places in California with his friends.

Title: 675. Mr. Rossi Looks for Happiness
description: Mr. Rossi is a cartoon character of the Italian cartoonist Bruno Bozzetto.

Title: 676. Summer of Secrets
description: A young couple venture into a summer beach house and make passionate love, unaware that they are being observed by a demented doctor who later uses the girl as part of a bizarre experiment.

Title: 677. Puss 'n Boots: Travels Around the World
description: Puss 'N Boots must travel around the world in 80 days, all while getting into adventures wherever he goes.

Title: 678. Docteur Françoise Gailland
description: Dr. Françoise Gailland has a hectic schedule, which causes her to have little time to spend with her family, which consists of her husband Gérard, her pregnant teenager daughter Élisabeth, and her sullen son Julien. However, she does manage to find the time to spend with her lover, Daniel Letessier. While her life in such disarray, she learns that she has cancer. Françoise tries to put a brave face on it, and is determined to face the life-threatening disease with courage.

Title: 679. Lunatics and Lovers
description: During a furious storm the Marquis Luca Maria Sbrisson sees his wife Luisa disappearing before his eyes.

Title: 681. Panama Red
description: A hippie musician needs to make $60,000 through selling high grade Panama Red in just three days to pay back a drug smuggler known as The Money Man.

Title: 682. Savana violenta
description: The film documents various scenes of graphic behavior in an attempted exposé of worldly violence.

Title: 683. Hallo Baby
description: About a girl growing up in a big city in the seventies. She cultivates her artistic ambitions. After a series of relationships, she gets a small part in a play and becomes pregnant.

Title: 684. Les vécés étaient fermés de l'intérieur
description: Superintendent Pichard investigates the death of a toilet attendant.

Title: 685. Hamlet
description: Hamlet (Tony Meyer) suspects his uncle, King Claudius (Barry Stanton) has murdered his father to claim the throne of Denmark and the hand of Hamlet's mother, Gertrude (Dame Helen Mirren), but the Prince cannot decide whether or not he should take vengeance.

Title: 686. Tracks
description: A soldier (Dennis Hopper) returns from Vietnam on special assignment, accompanying the body of his friend by train to California for burial. During the trip, he falls in love with a gentle college student. But their relationship is shattered by his flashbacks to combat.

Title: 687. The Last Supper
description: A pious plantation owner attempts to teach Christianity to 12 of his slaves by inviting them to participate in a reenactment of the Last Supper.

Title: 688. Wan Pipel
description: Roy is a handsome Surinam man, who studies in Amsterdam. He hurriedly left his Dutch girlfriend Karina to visit his dying mom in Paramaribo. Back in his homeland, Roy soon becomes obsessed with his own country and its culture. When he falls for the Hindu nurse Rubia, the conservative Hindu and Black communities are in revolt. One day Karina arrives in Surinam too.

Title: 689. Idealist
description: Screen Adaptation of a classic socio-critical novel.

Title: 690. Emilia, parada y fonda
description: An attractive girl weighed down by a puritanical moral formation, raised by an aunt, strikes up a relationship with a businessman much older than her. She ends up marrying him, and it is then that she experiences love for a man her age.

Title: 691. Zonja nga qyteti
description: It is a comedy about an old albanian lady and her daughter who move from the city to a village. Her daughter falls in love while she is there but her mother (Ollga) will try everything to marry her with a man who comes from the city.

Title: 692. Charas
description: Ramniklal lives in Uganda with his son Suraj and daughter Radha when tensions arise in the country and Asians are forced to leave he decides to return back to India.On the day they are about to leave their house is set on fire and Ramniklal passes away Suraj manages to escape with Radha but notices that the women whom he saved and bought out of the house is their maid in Radha's clothes Suraj believes that Radha got burnt in the house but nobody is found to be there leaving with a hope of she being alive.Suraj reaches India where his ancestral property is taken over by Kaalicharan a smuggler who tries to kill him in order to save his life he hides in car of a dancer name Sudha.A stranger claiming to be rival of Kaalicharan decides to help Suraj get his property and find Radha but he turns out to be a cop who wants Suraj to expose Kaalcharan's smuggling racket where Suraj also finds that Sudha is being forced into this business where she is blackmailed by Kaalicharan.

Title: 693. Le jour de gloire
description: In 1944, a retired German detachment found itself stranded in a French town. The inhabitants try to live in good harmony with the occupants. But one day kids, playing with a grenade, accidentally cause the death of an SS lieutenant.

Title: 694. Lulekuqet mbi mure
description: A tale of orphaned Albanian children coping with life in an orphanage and Italian occupation while acquainting themselves with communist ideas.

Title: 695. Lettomania
description: Giulio is a young boy who still does not know which path to take in life, his father puts him in his place in the bank, but he's too lazy to accept. One day during a photo shoot in London, Max meets a girl, Dora.

Title: 696. 7 Man Army
description: The six surviving soldiers of a decimated battalion stand their ground protecting an important fort on the battlefield during the Sino-Japanese war.

Title: 697. Sternsteinhof
description: Daytaler Leni has the strong will to one day belong to the people "up there" on the Sternstein Manor. Thus she abandons her fiancé Muckerl and instead enmeshes Toni, the son of the landholder. She even manages to wangle a written marriage vow out of him.

Title: 698. He's a Legend, He's a Hero
description: A highly fictionalized biography of the famous Bruce Lee, this movie traces his college life, his marriage to Linda Lee, his relationship with his master, and his untimely death.

Title: 699. Khaan Dost
description: Naive, simple-minded Ramdin Pandey lives a poor lifestyle in Nasik, India, along with his sister, Shanti, and works as a Havaldar in the Nasik Central Jail. He arranges Shanti's marriage but the prospective groom's family want Rs.5000/- which he is unable to afford. To make matters due to his simplistic job performance he has not been promoted. Then their jail gets a new inmate, the dreaded Rehmat Khan, who has been found guilty of killing Ranga for allegedly attempting to molest his prostitute mistress, Zareena. Rehmat finds out about Ramdin's weakness, befriends and then uses him to escape on the pretext of visiting his ailing mother in Bombay, and never returns. A furious Jailor, Sharma, asks Ramdin to travel to Bombay, locate Rehmat, and then return or else he will not only lose his job but also be prosecuted. A hapless Ramdin agrees to do so - little knowing that soon he will be at the mercy of the cunning and cruel Rehmat as well as Ranga's vengeful brother, Jaggi.

Title: 700. Na samote u lesa
description: The Lavicka's, a Czech family from the city, rents a house in the country with the option to buy. However, old Mr Komarek seems reluctant to sell the house as they agreed.

Title: 701. Piger i trøjen 2
description: A female lieutenant is married to a NATO official who knows nothing about her military career.

Title: 702. Cross Shot
description: A mobster kills a cop during a robbery so he finds himself pursued by the police, his gang, and the media.

Title: 703. My Friends Need Killing
description: A Vietnam veteran goes on a crime spree and starts torturing and killing men he served in the army with.

Title: 705. Mission to Glory: A True Story
description: A true account of the legendary "Padre on Horseback", Father Eusebio Francisco Kino a Jesuit missionary who helped the lives of the Native Americans. He faced many challenges on his trips throughout California, Arizona and Mexico

Title: 706. Les emmerdeuses
description: Pina and Tina, two cabaret artists with a passion for espionage and theft, discover that a carpet seller named Kashfi has some extraordinary diamonds stolen from the millionaire Radeck.

Title: 707. Kaftes diakopes
description: A group of friends get involved in a "game" inspired by a writer and kidnap the young daughter of a happy couple for fun. But the girl's father triggers a cycle of vengeance and murder no one could have foreseen.

Title: 708. Operation 'The Monster'
description: A group of five work colleagues leave for an expedition in the Danube Delta, without letting their wives know anything about it. Going fishing and hunting, the characters end up in the funniest and ridiculous situations.

Title: 709. Sparkle's Tavern
description: A brother and sister who run a bordello worry that their conservative mother will find out what they do for a living. But all of their worlds are rocked when a mysterious magic man unexpectedly arrives at their mother's door.

Title: 710. La prima notte di nozze
description: Ciriaco married Salomè, Giovanni's widow, who, having arrived in the same hotel and in the same room where in Venice she had passed the first wedding note, would use a tape recorder to try to relive it in playback.

Title: 711. The Spy Who Never Was
description: A diabolical tale of romance, murder, and mistaken identity as a treacherous terrorist organization hunts an enemy agent with the intention of killing him, but instead they set their sights on the wrong man. Left in the wake of their mistaken pursuit is a trail of broken lives and brutal murders.

Title: 712. Zona roja
description: Leonor works in a brothel called El Paraiso, in a Caribbean environment. Juan, a man in love with Leonor, has escaped from prison. Both Leonor and John want a new life, but they are hampered by the shadow of their past.

Title: 713. Secuestro
description: Naschy plays a member of a kidnapping gang in a story inspired by the famous Patricia Hearst case. The frightened and psychologically traumatized kidnapped woman, played by Maria Jose Cantudo, succumbs to the "Stockholm Syndrome," in which the victimized become sympathetic to the victimizer. The Naschy character, more humane than the other members of his gang, becomes the recipient of her affections. One of the rarest of Naschy films.

Title: 714. In Search of Bigfoot
description: A documentary about the search for the legendary Bigfoot, a large humanoid creature (also known as Sasquatch) who is rumored to inhabit the forests of the U.S. Pacific Northwest.

Title: 715. Andréa
description: A satire of the movie series "Emmanuelle".

Title: 716. Wet Vase
description: Naomi Tani plays bar-owner Aki, whose entire world seems to be crumbling when she discovers her husband is having an affair with her own mother.

Title: 717. Paadipantalu
description: Gopalam, a villager who relies on agriculture to earn a living, fights against the corrupt persons in order to assist the construction of a dam for the well being of all the people in the village.

Title: 718. Atlantic City Jackpot
description: A prominent businessman's children become the target of a young, unemployed man, who sees them as his ticket to wealth.

Title: 719. Quel movimento che mi piace tanto
description: Noblewoman Livia and her friend Marquis Cecco Ottobuoni take revenge against politician Fabrizio Siniscalchi, Livia's lover who dumped her for political reasons, by setting him up with young prostitute Anna to cause a scandal.

Title: 720. Mehbooba
description: A singer by profession, Suraj (Rajesh Khanna) gets stranded in resthouse in the coutnryside during a rainstorm. While there he experiences ununsual feelings, as if he has been there before. He feels himself transported to another time and era, to another birth, and drawn to a woman named Ratna (Hema Malini). He is unable to leave this experience behind him, and decides to find out what this means. He discovers that in his past life he was a Chief Singer in the emperor's court, his name was Prakash and he had fallen in love with a courtesan named Ratna, much to the chargin and anger of his family and the emperor's and his officials. They are tragically separated. He subsequently comes across a portrait of Ratna, and shortly after he meets a gypsy, Jhumri (also Hema Malini) who looks exactly like Ratna. Soon Jhumri is also able to recollect her past life, and her love for Prakash. This does not auger well with Rita Malhotra (Asha Sachdev) who loves Suraj, and Appa (Prem Chopra), the son of the leader of the gypsies (Madan Puri), who will not stop at anything to make Jhumri his wife. Appa steals the portrait, and instigates the gypsies against Suraj, so that he can marry Jhumri, and perhaps separate the two lovers again in this birth also.

Title: 721. The Pyramid
description: A young TV news reporter grows tired of Commercial programming and decides to cover more positive stories. He is fired for his troubles, and goes on a personal search for truth and beauty in the media. A voyage in consciousness for the millenium.

Title: 722. The Electric Chair
description: The murder of an innocent, happy couple leads to a courtroom trial that would sentence the killer to death, but who really did it?

Title: 723. The Drug Connection
description: A nurse decides to take justice in her own hands to fight the crime-syndicates of Hong Kong after her sister is drugged and abused by some local drug dealers.

Title: 724. Vortex
description: Christopher Tauling, a U.N. official, is leading an effort to warn the authorities worldwide that a bacterial weapon is at the ready to wipe out most of mankind.

Title: 726. Yesterday's Guys Used No Arsenic
description: Mara Ordaz, a former diva who lives in a mansion away from the city and sorrounded by memories together with her husband, her doctor and the person in charge of the administration of her things, decides to sell her house and return to the big city. The men do not agree with this. She will call an estate agent, a young woman who will make a change within this group of people. A chain of events will bring to an unexpected ending.

Title: 727. The One Armed Swordsmen
description: The martial world is now awash in one-armed knights, who aren't inclined to make any permanent alliances among themselves.

Title: 728. Luna di miele in tre
description: On the eve of his wedding trip (destination Sanremo) Alfredo Riva learns that he had won a contest of "Playmen" whose prize is a five-day vacation in Jamaica together, day and night, with the beautiful playmate Christine.

Title: 729. Violence for Kicks
description: A gang of young and ruthless bikers terrorizes the streets of Rome for no other reason than kicks and to kill their copious amounts of spare time.

Title: 730. Pipe Dreams
description: Pipe Dreams is a 1976 film starring soul singer Gladys Knight in her acting debut as a woman who attempts to regain the love of her husband played by real-life spouse Barry Hankerson. In this drama, her husband must choose between reuniting with her or giving in to pressure of the local boss.

Title: 731. Skaz pro to, kak tsar Pyotr arapa zhenil
description: Loosely based on Peter the Great's Negro, Alexander Pushkin's unfinished novel based on his own great-grandfather, a black African brought to Russia.

Title: 732. Violent Panic: The Big Crash
description: Takashi, a bank robber, dreams of his final heist and escaping to Brazil. But in his way, stands a woman that loves him, his dead partner's brother, a corrupt cop, a motorcycle gang and every police officer in the Kanto region.

Title: 733. Le grand escogriffe
description: The aging villain Émile Morland talks his old friend Aristide into helping him with to kidnap the son of a millionaire.

Title: 734. Everyone Dies Alone
description: When they start losing family members and neighbors due to World War II and the German government's policies, a quiet married couple becomes disillusioned and begins spreading leaflets against the government - a crime punishable by death.

Title: 735. Once a Moth
description: A young nurse questions her planned emigration to the United States, and her country's post-colonial conditions, following her brother's fatal shooting by an American soldier from the nearby military base.

Title: 736. La ragazza dalla pelle di corallo
description: Arriving in Santo Domingo to study new methods of cultivation of tobacco, Fabrizio is hosted by American Barrymore who feels compelled to provide Mayra, beautiful mulatta, as momentary escort.

Title: 737. Annakili
description: The story of a teacher who struggles to look after his mother and sister.

Title: 738. Cassiodoro il più duro del pretorio
description: Adventures of the Etruscan Cassiodorus who, after having involuntarily captured a rebel, is named centurion and ingratiates himself with Nero. He tries to take advantage of his role to enrich himself with shady deals, but it goes wrong.

Title: 740. Lost, Lost, Lost
description: Artist-writer-poet-filmmaker Jonas Mekas documents his early years building a life and discovering an arts community in New York.

Title: 741. Las largas vacaciones del 36
description: In the summer of 1936, the beginning of the Spanish Civil War, a bourgeois family with many children, spending their holiday near Barcelona, tries to remain neutral between the Republicans and the supporters of General Franco.

Title: 743. Loma
description: A shy Finn boards a wrong plane and ends up on a beach holiday instead of skiing.

Title: 745. Moi, Pierre Rivière, ayant égorgé ma mère, ma soeur et mon frère...
description: In 1835, Pierre Rivière, a young peasant, brutally murdered his mother, sister, and brother in 19th-century rural Normandy.

Title: 746. The Great Okinawa Yakuza War
description: Set in Okinawa 1971, one year before the return of power to the mainland, this film highlights the bloody battle of Okinawa Yakuza gangsters versus mainland system.

Title: 747. Brunet Will Call
description: Modest editor, has shipped his wife and kids for the weekend, and is trying to relax in his house at the outskirts of Warsaw. His quiet evening is only disturbed by the accidental forecast made by a Gypsy woman, that at evening time he will murder a mysterious brunet. He is trying to escape the destiny, but to no avail...

Title: 748. The Red Poster
description: A company wants to make a play about Mont Valerien resistant fighters who were shot by the Nazis and the French collaborators.

Title: 749. Mastermind
description: Zero Mostel plays an inspector on the trail of criminals who have captured a robot called Chatze (sp?) played by Felix Sillas. The inspector has delusions that he is a great Samurai warrior and the movie flashes back and forth between present day and ancient times.

Title: 750. The Amazing World of Psychic Phenomena
description: Documentary exploring such phenomena as astral projection, telekinesis, telepathy, voices from beyond the grave, ghosts/spirits, etc.

Title: 751. Il maestro di violino
description: The violin teacher at the Perugia Conservatory in Italy is loved by his female pupils and the rich ladies in town. Later we learn that he was a great concert soloist and had to give up his career because of his drunkard wife.

Title: 752. A Whisper in the Dark
description: Martino is a young child who claims to have an invisible friend called Luca. His parents assume it is just a game, but strange things start to happen...

Title: 753. The Milpitas Monster
description: A town is terrorized by a monster that was created by local environmental pollution.

Title: 754. Kilma, reina de las amazonas
description: A sailor escapes a mutiny on his ship and finds himself stranded on a jungle island--with a tribe of gorgeous amazon women.

Title: 755. Kinkakuji
description: "Temple of the Golden Pavillion" - About the psychological decline of a novice Buddhist monk. After the death of his father, the stammering Goichi Mizoguchi seeks succour and loftier insights in religion. Only to find all too soon that reality and the imagination are worlds apart. The social upheavals that began after World War II did not stop even at Buddhist temples. Convinced that all loftier values have long since degenerated, he sets fire to the Kinkaku-ji temple, thereby annihilating the symbol of his own dashed hopes.

Title: 757. Salas u Malom Ritu
description: Set in a small village during WWII, a group of boys have to rely on their cunning to fool a dangerous Nazi policeman who's come to their village to find out who burned down the German corn supply.

Title: 758. Lasse & Geir
description: The teenagers Lasse and Geir are arrested after making trouble on a night bus into town. After a night in the slammer they go home. To Geir's alcoholic mother and to Lasse's father, who is terrorizing the entire family.

Title: 759. Death Riders
description: Documentary goes on the road with state fair daredevils.

Title: 760. The Far Shore
description: A young woman marries a wealthy man she isn't in love with, but finds romance instead with the couples' painter friend.

Title: 761. Pascual Duarte
description: Early Spain of the 20th century. Bad luck, misery and tragedies are a trend in Pascual Duarte's family. But when the weight of the things are too heavy to bear, a reckless man who only follows his impulses, will fall into a descent to madness that slowly alters the course of his life and of others as well.

Title: 762. The Blazing Temple
description: In an attempt to eliminate all possible nationalist fractions, the Ching Emperor (Wong) orders the destruction of the Shaolin Temple - considered the focus of anti-Manchurian resistance. As the temple burns, the surviving 106 Shaolin disciples vow to penetrate the Imperial Palace and take ultimate revenge on the tyrant.

Title: 763. The Dragon Missile
description: An evil gang of martial artists fight for a healing elixir against a specialist that fights with boomerang blades - the Dragon Missiles!

Title: 766. Victory March
description: The young student Paolo Passeri is firmly anti-militarist but has to do his military service.

Title: 767. Une femme fatale
description: A young, easygoing pilot discovers the mutual attraction between his chief pilot's wife and himself. The two become lovers, and are nearly discovered on several occasions.

Title: 768. La muerte del escorpión
description: The film plunges the intrigue of a love triangle in which is involved a former actress who has a relationship with her husband, a film producer, her lover, the screenwriter of the films he produces, and a criminal lawyer.

Title: 769. A Noite das Fêmeas
description: On a theater stage, four actresses play prostitutes whose desire is to kill the gigolo who exploits them. After carrying out their plan, they drink wine. The drink, however, is poisoned.

Title: 770. Roxani, i odysseia tou sex
description: Eddie is impotent in marriage with Roxanne arranged by his father, who earlier was Roxanne's lover.

Title: 771. La Corea
description: Toni is a seventeen year old young man who comes to Madrid from a little village in search of work. A friend from the same village of Toni puts him in touch with Charo, "La Corea", a mature woman dedicated to facilitating contacts and boys to American men at the military base of Torrejón.

Title: 772. Maiden Bridge
description: ''Maiden Bridge'' is a place of exchange of German prisoners and partisans captured by the Germans. With the position of moving columns of fighters and nine captured Germans. Way to bridge the partisans double temptation: Veterans and because from all lurking dangers and ethical, because they have to be at risk because of an enemy who has been relentless.

Title: 773. Bajrangbali
description: Vanar family tale: Pawan and Anjani's son Bajrangbali, with brothers Sugreev and Vali, gains divine powers and serves Lord Ram. He helps rescue Sita from Lanka, fights demons, and remains Ram's devoted ally through conflicts.

Title: 775. Killers on Wheels
description: Two guys and their women constantly get harassed by a group of young motorcycle outlaws on a small island. The situation becomes deadly when one of them gets killed.

Title: 776. Soy un delincuente
description: Ramón has deal with the rampant violence, drugs, sex and petty thievery of a Caracas slum. Ramón moves on to serious gang activity and robberies. His views change when his fiance's brother is killed in a robbery.

Title: 777. Longitud de guerra
description: In 1886 the residents of a town in Chihuahua reject the abuses of the authorities and the army.

Title: 778. The Flying Superboy
description: Baba is an infamous gang leader. He threatens everyone and collects "protection money". Recently another gangster named Riza has appeared. He uses Baba's name and collects the money under his name. Baba tries everything to stop him, but cannot succeed.

Title: 779. Santo vs. the She-Wolves
description: Luba, a werewolf woman, revives to destroy humanity. Cesar Hacker, a man who fights against the wolves, asks the Saint for help, for he is the symbol of silver, the only thing that can destroy the wolves.

Title: 780. Motylem jestem, czyli romans czterdziestolatka
description: A 40-year-old engineer Stefan Karwowski falls in love with a famous singer Irena Orska. The problem is that he's married and has got two children. What will he choose - his new lover or his family?

Title: 781. Underground
description: It's the mid 1970s and the Weather Underground Organization (WUO), a radical (and violent) offshoot of the Students for a Democratic Society, explains to leftist filmmakers the difficulties and experiences of being underground and wanted by the federal government.

Title: 782. Possuidas Pelo Pecado
description: Dr. Leme, a rich old man, is frustrated about not having children with his wife Raquel. In his mansion, he gives parties filled with drinking and sex with his secretaries. André, his driver, becomes lover of Rachel and they plan to kill Lemer to get hold of his fortune.

Title: 783. The Zebra Force
description: A group of Vietnam vets, tired of the depredation of the Mafia on their neighborhood, decide to take on the mob on their own terms--but by using a very different twist.

Title: 784. F... comme Fairbanks
description: André, a hot-tempered young man, whiles away his spare time by fantasizing about the action films of Douglas Fairbanks.

Title: 785. Vise od igre
description: Popular TV series has been reedited into a theatrical film with additional material that has not been seen on TV before. The film is a homage to the legends of the Yugoslav theater, some of whom are no longer alive. The story takes place in the town for ten years from 1931 to 1941 and shows the conflict of progressive and humane ideas with fascism. A film made from the TV series of the same name (nine episodes) realized in 1976 and shown in 1977.

Title: 786. Más allá del deseo
description: Mónica has just died in a traffic accident. Along with her was another man. Pedro Bernáldez, painter and lover of Mónica, was so in love with her that he came to change his painting style for the one indicated by his lover. Now that Mónica has died, Pedro will investigate what relationship the deceased had with each other and begins to discover many things.

Title: 787. Marecek, Pass Me the Pen!
description: Older group of workers are forced to attend the high school and finish it.

Title: 788. Grand Jury
description: A man and his wife who are witnesses to a crime find themselves ensnared in a legal system that appears to be treating them as worse criminals than the ones they are supposed to testify against.

Title: 789. Deux imbéciles heureux
description: 12-year-old Bruno got fed up with his bickering parents and so he runs off into the countryside where he befriends a recluse.

Title: 790. Robin Hood... Arrow, Beans and Karate
description: Robin Hood fights the evil Sheriff of Nothingham. Friar Tuck brings his friend Moi Kato, a Kung Fu master. Medival movie meets Italo Eastern.

Title: 791. Montana Trap
description: Potato farmer, Fritz, moves to Wild West with his fellow German immigrants. Bandits pretending to be Native Americans on the war path besieged them in an attempt to steal some gold.

Title: 792. Ligaw na bulaklak
description: An innocent young woman (Alma Moreno) who sells flowers in a small-town cabaret frequented by down-and-out prostitutes is lusted after by the son (Nonong de Andres) of a school principal, played by Anita Linda. An aging gardener (Palito) takes her in to try to protect her from the harsh world, though secretly, he too lusts after the young girl, in spite of his impotence caused by the war. She goes to school, where morality and empty platitudes are mouthed, but the attempts at life's lessons are foiled by the realities of the cabaret world. While the school and the gardener try to protect her innocence, the young girl is lured by the temptation of the worldly cabaret, and her womanhood is awakened.

Title: 793. Rome: The Other Side of Violence
description: Four bandits kidnap a villa: the maid calls the police and Commissioner Ferreri immediately warns Commissioner Carli, who orders the patrols to chase the four.

Title: 794. Bomber & Paganini
description: The story follows two simple as well as incorrigible petty crooks, who always fail spectacularly in search of the big coup.

Title: 795. The Lonely Supporter
description: Reckless Ebi is introduced to cafe singer Nasrin by his brother, Karim. Manipulated by her boss Abbas, Ebi seeks revenge on Karim. When Nasrin reveals her past romance with Karim, Ebi defends his brother, sacrificing his own life.

Title: 796. The Last Affair
description: The wife of a sterile man steps outside the marriage with a gigolo in order to conceive.

Title: 797. Nevermore, Forever
description: After the death of her best friend Agathe, Claire returns to Paris. In mourning, lost, Claire finds Mathieu, whom she had probably not forgotten. Between them, something is reborn, starts again.

Title: 798. D'amour et d'eau fraîche
