description: Jip, a young man of twenty-five who gives a few piano lessons for a living, shares his life with Mona, a triumphant forty-year-old. The romance is shattered by the arrival of the young and pretty Dutch girl Rita

Title: 799. As Granfinas e o Camelô
description: Three socialites place a strange bet: to turn a rude hawker into a gentleman in thirty days. They choose a guy from Rio de Janeiro, but he has a strong personality that isn't easily influenced. To complicate things, they all end up falling in love with him.

Title: 800. Adulterio a la española
description: Fernando and Marta form an exemplary marriage. Fernando, an orderly and methodical person, works as an executive for a multinational. One fine day, she arrives at the Susan delegation, to work as Fernando's secretary.

Title: 801. Karate Warriors
description: A karate fighter and a samurai join opposing gangs to take them down from the inside.

Title: 802. All This and World War II
description: WWII newsreel footage intercut with Beatles songs performed by other artists like Helen Reddy and Rod Stewart, juxtaposing the music with war imagery.

Title: 803. A mí qué me importa que explote Miami
description: A wedding is taking place in a small Spanish town. After the ceremony, the groom thinks the moment he has dreamed of for so long has finally arrived. The bride's grandmother leads him out of his mistake, as she herself escorts the couple to the airstair of the plane that will take them to Miami. His granddaughter must remain pure for as long as possible. At last they settle into the "bridal suite" of the most luxurious hotel. She prepares for the big moment; he waits eagerly and impatiently. A tremendous explosion. Immediately, the hotel is surrounded by the Army. A small capsule of high radioactive content has been embedded in one of the bride's buttocks. The bride, and especially that part of her anatomy, is now declared a "military zone", and only the Army has access to it. When, finally, the radioactivity has been eliminated and the newlyweds are about to restart their honeymoon, a spectacular accident forces the husband to remain immobilized for several months. Again the Army will have to take care of her, now to console her in the face of the helpless despair of her husband.

Title: 804. Last Days of the Boss
description: Sugawara plays Nozaki, a laborer who swears allegiance to a sympathetic crime boss, only to find himself elected his successor after the boss is murdered. Restrained by a gang alliance that forbids retributions against high-level members, Nozaki forms a plot to exact revenge on his rivals, but a suspicious relationship with his own sister taints his relationship with his fellow gang members.

Title: 805. Ragazzo di borgata
description: A boy from the Roman suburbs makes ends meet with petty thefts that do not satisfy him.

Title: 806. The Blank Generation
description: Live footage of NYC's early punk/new wave bands at CBGB's, featuring Patti Smith, Blondie, Television, Ramones, Talking Heads, Heartbreakers, Shirts, Wayne County, Marbles, Dolls, Miamis, Harry Toledo and Tuff Darts.

Title: 807. Le berceau de cristal
description: An androgynous poet/dreamer sits and writes and meditates on the aching void that is her life.

Title: 808. MitGift
description: Edgar Burgman, after collaborating to assassinate the elder senator husband of Alice Young, the wife remarried. The woman, after a short period, doubts of love Edgar and convinces more and more that, having married out of interest, now wants to eliminate the possession of his great assets.

Title: 809. Dus Numbri
description: A police officer framed for drug possession escapes jail while his wife is institutionalized. Years later, their son becomes a feared crime boss who falls for a thief, leading to dangerous consequences.

Title: 810. Enforcer from Death Row
description: A former ranger sits in prison awaiting his execution when an international organization frees him and assigns him to crush a deadly spy ring.

Title: 811. Maha Chor
description: Orphaned at a young age, Neetu Singh lives a wealthy lifestyle in Raigadh in a palace which is presided over by her aunt, Rani Maa, and Neetu's paternal uncle, Rajan Singh. She travels and lives for a few years in Switzerland, then returns back to Bombay, India, and has a run-in with some slum-dwellers near Juhu. A few days later she is abducted by two men, who had initially claimed to be palace guards, and is rescued by a male named Raju Khan, a career thief and con-man, who was one of the slum dwellers in Juhu. She reaches Raigadh and shortly thereafter is shocked to find out that Raju is claiming to be the long-lost son of Rani Maa and her betrothed. Her disbelief turns to love when the Court Astrologer confirms that Raju indeed is the sole heir to Raigadh, and both of them fall in love with each other much to the displeasure of Prem Singh, the illegitimate son of Dilip Singh (brother of Rajan) who wants Neetu and Raigadh for himself. What Neetu does not know is that Prem has hired Raju to impersonate Rani Maa's son.

Title: 812. To Dream, to Dream
description: Mario "el Rulo" ("Curly", Gianfranco Pagliaro) is a globetrotter who travels the inner country offering artistic performances. One day, he happens to come to the hometown of Carlos (Carlos Monzon), a townhall employee who wishes to be an artist. The men become friends and Carlos leaves his small-town life to follow Mario Together they will try the adventure of being famous.

Title: 813. Nehle Pe Dehlaa
description: A kingpin smuggler kills a police officer and succeeds in separating his teen-aged sons. The elder son who had vowed to take revenge, accidentally meets his younger brother. The two join forces to bust the smugglers gang.

Title: 814. Safari Express
description: Two safari tour-guides and business partners find in the African jungle a wandering stunning blonde who suffers from amnesia.

Title: 815. Bruce Lee Superstar
description: Bruce Li plays Bruce Lee in this epic biopic.

Title: 816. Obrazki z zycia
description: Seven different stories tells us about interesting life of people in Poland. First tells us about romance, second about young actress, third about girl who escape from home with music band, fourth about divorce, five about quarrel of two girls about the man, sixth about stolen soups, seventh about false writer.

Title: 817. El calor de la llama
description: Gabriela is married to a man several years older than her. This age difference creates conflict in the couple, who are going through a major crisis.

Title: 818. Vergewaltigt
description: A brutally raped young woman becomes pregnant, ends up at a sex party where "experienced" rapists show off their successes, and has an illegal abortion.

Title: 819. Violent Milan
description: A gang pulls a robbery, which goes seriously awry. In their eagerness to escape they start shooting and it turns into a bloodbath, after which they take hostages in their escape attempt. Soon the gang turns on one of its members and tries to kill him, but they fail and it turns out to be the biggest mistake they ever made.

Title: 820. Moments of Erotic Passion
description: Angela is married with Andreas a young gigolo who sleeps also with her best friend. Angela pays their maid to sleep with him and take photos so she can divorce him. The only problem is that he is too ambitious to let her go.

Title: 821. Blood Voyage
description: What is meant to be a pleasure cruise becomes a nightmare as murder follows murder on a small ship. With tension mounting, passengers and the crew turn on each other in a desperate attempt to identify the killer.

Title: 822. Meanwhile, Back at the Ranch
description: The "Rattler" is secretly the head of an outlaw band have been terrorizing the residents of Peaceful Valley with a crime wave of rustling, killing and robbing. The Federal Government has sent for its best 25 agents to clean up the valley. These 25 are to drift into town and meet at the Dirty Dog Saloon.

Title: 823. Un toro da monta
description: Salvatore is a virile man in every sense—much like the bull he rents out to impregnate cows, an animal with which he shares a very intimate bond. He never misses the mark; yet, when he marries the beautiful Sabrina, he is so deeply in love—and idealizes her to such an extent—that he finds himself unable to consummate the marriage. His cousin, Concetta steps in to help him overcome this psychological block and resolve the issue, using methods inspired by a peculiar book written by a certain Professor Von Kazzen.

Title: 824. The Trespassers
description: In 1970, political journalist Richard lives with Penny but is having an affair with actress Dee. The two women meet and become friends.

Title: 826. La sposina
description: A shop assistant in a record shop falls in love with a young writer, who loves classical music but can not find a publisher who publishes his first novel.

Title: 827. The Big Boss Part II
description: Cheng Chao-Chun visits his brother in Thailand, then finds a job as an ice factory worker.

Title: 828. Aleluia, Gretchen
description: A German family moves to a small town in the interior of the state of Paraná, Brazil, and buys a hotel there, which soon becomes sort of a meeting point for Nazi sympathizers.

Title: 830. The Yakuza Code Still Lives
description: Yakuza in Hiroshima fight to dominate corporate extortion rackets.

Title: 832. Barood
description: Young Anup Saxena lives a middle-classed lifestyle in Bombay along with his widower dad, Durgaprasad, who works as a Police Inspector. Anup's life is turned upside down when he witnesses four men assault and kill his father. He spends the rest of his childhood acquiring money and athletic ability to avenge his father's death - a decision that will take him to Las Vegas, New York, Geneva, Madrid and Paris - where he will find his life threatened by his father's assailants as well as a New York-based detective who is determined to arrest him at any and all costs.

Title: 833. Merciless Man
description: The city suffers and succumbs unarmed, but an ex secret agent succeeds in winning the struggle against the gangsterism. Intrigue and violence grip a society victim of the crime.

Title: 834. El hombre que supo amar
description: The life of Juan de Dios and his struggle against social, political and religious structures.

Title: 835. Justine
description: Stewart Mackinnon's avant-garde adaptation of Marquis de Sade's infamous erotic novel has been near impossible to see since 1976.

Title: 837. Rosemaries Tochter
description: Annemarie's mother, the well-known noble prostitute Rosemarie Nitribitt, was found murdered nearly twenty years ago.

Title: 838. The Longest Bridge
description: A battalion of Chinese soldiers defend the Sihang (4 Bank) warehouse from the invading Japanese army in 1937 at the end of the Battle of Shanghai during the Second Sino-Japanese War. There are only 452 defenders, but to mislead the Japanese they tell the outside world that they are 800 in number. Their heroism leads to them becoming known as the 800 Heroes.

Title: 839. Princess Chang Ping
description: Love story of Princess Changping, the last princess of the Ming Dynasty in China.

Title: 840. Pony Express Rider
description: In 1861 Texas, the son of a poor farmer vows to avenge his father's murder committed by the spoiled son of a rich cattleman.

Title: 841. The Punishment
description: In 1919 at the end of WW1 Romanian peasant Manolache Preda returns to his native village where he finds his woman taken by another and his land sold to the local landowner.

Title: 843. Les oeufs brouillés
description: Brumaire, the director of public relations at the Élysée, is trying to boost the rating of his government.

Title: 844. Monsieur Albert
description: An unwed woman hesitates between two men whose relationship turns into a fight to the death.

Title: 845. L'eau chaude, l'eau frette
description: In a poor neighborhood, teenagers plot an assassination while a party is being organized for the local usurer.

Title: 846. Ha Khel Savlyancha
description: Indumati lives with her step mother Sushila (Vahinisaheb) in their palatial home in a small village, Indumati loves to live a simple life and spends her time with village girls and also dresses like them,Sushila is not happy with her life as she became widow at a young age and after Indumati grew up she doesn't have full rights to the property.Sushila's brother Ganu comes to her house where Sushila shares a secret with him that when Indumati was 10 years old on a stormy rainy day she wanted a coconut from coconut tree their servant Narsu climbed the tree in heavy rains while coming down he jumped on a stone mistakenly and died and his wife became insane everyone since believe that the tree his haunted and Narsu's spirit is around it.Shekar a Bombay based Doctor comes to the village with proposal to marry Indumati after some funny moments their marriage is about to take place but Indumati gets possessed by spirit of Narsu and decides to give her life to him but Shekar says that he will try his best to free Indumati from evil spirit.

Title: 848. Crueldade Mortal
description: Man leaves his family behind and moves to Nova Iguaçu, a poor and violent city in the outskirts of Rio de Janeiro. He tries to rebuild his life, but falls in love with a woman who despises him, which drives him mad.

Title: 849. Beyond the Last Mountain
description: In a life surrounded by political and social ills, a young man realizes that there is more about his father than he already knows.

Title: 850. Señoritas de uniforme
description: Three young women radically change their lives by signing up for the Female Traffic Police Corps. As they face demanding training and hit the city streets on patrol while swept up in comic situations, romance, and family clashes.

Title: 851. Tanase Scatiu
description: The rise and fall of the opportunistic Tanase Scatiu, a boyar in 19th century Wallachia.

Title: 852. The Secret of Navajo Cave
description: Directed by James T. Flocker, The Legend of Cougar Canyon follows the trail of two young boys travelling through the sacred Navajo land of mysterious Cougar Canyon. Their good intentions are to rescue a lost goat, but the legends and inherent dangers of the haunted canyon are not necessarily sympathetic to their presence.

Title: 853. Fakira
description: Vijay helps the poor and robs the rich, while Ajay is assigned the job to bring Vijay to justice. Thirsty for each other's blood, both men are unaware that they are brothers separated at a young age.

Title: 854. Her Venetian Name in Deserted Calcutta
description: The life of Anne-Marie Stretter, wife of ambassador to India circa 1930.

Title: 855. Snake-Crane Secret
description: Snake-Crane Secret is a tale of deceit, lying and mistrust. A family tries to uphold their honor, while keeping their Sacred Kung-Fu book from getting into the wrong hands.

Title: 857. The Barren Zone
description: After 11 years in Siberia as a war criminal, a man joins a corporation making fighter planes to sell to the government but other corporations are competing with his firm for the enormous profit of such a deal.

Title: 858. Mr Rossi's Vacation
description: Mr. Rossi is a cartoon character of the Italian cartoonist Bruno Bozzetto.

Title: 859. The Snake Prince
description: Snake prince who want to married beautiful villager woman,but many people want to kill him.He has 2 bodyguards,3 of them can turned into a big snake.

Title: 861. Black Heat
description: Kicks Carter, a streetwise Las Vegs cop, is out to shut down an upscale hotel that is actually a front for a host of illegal activities. A gang headed by the scuzzy Ziggy is running everything from gun-running and loan-sharking to prostitution and drug-dealing, and a beautiful but nosy reporter keeps getting in Kicks' way.

Title: 863. Les grands moyens
description: In this film, the local mob wipes out an entire family for revenge, with the exception of a sweet little old aunt and her two daughters. Unfortunately for the killers, the sweet little old aunt is a vengeful Corsican who proceeds to hunt down and slay them for murdering her loved ones.

Title: 864. Santo in the Mystery of the Black Pearl
description: Santo faces thugs, death and betrayal as he chases jewel thieves across South America.

Title: 865. La India
description: A concerned Mexican boy shoots his mom and her lover while having sex, after which he is tormented by erotic nightmares. And then he becomes a horse and bull driver.

Title: 866. The Passion of Berenice
description: When a man appears in her life, a young woman of traditional manners who lives with her godmother suffers a deep and unusual transformation.

Title: 867. Sister Street Fighter: Fifth Level Fist
description: Although not an official sequel (Shihomi plays a different character), the film is often referred to as a sequel to the series. Kiku Nakakawa, the only daughter of an old kimono shop owner in Kyoto, is enthusiastic about karate. In order to help her friend Michi avenge her brother, she sneaks into a movie studio in Kyoto where a drug dealing syndicate is based.

Title: 868. Do Jasoos
description: Two bumbling, middle-aged private detectives, Dharamchand and Karamchand, are assigned to locate the missing daughter, Asha, of a multi-millionaire. Their adventures take them to a gangster named Prem Chopra and a criminal don named Motilal Sippy. With a lot of skill, action, and fights, they do rescue the girl in their captivity, and bring her to her dad. It is then that they find out that the real Asha is already back home safe and sound, and they had rescued the wrong girl. But now it is too late, as the underworld and it's men are out to get them.

Title: 869. Jai Mahalaxmi Maa
description: The protagonist Gauri and her husband Bansi, who is a devotee of Mahalaxmi Maa and has faith in her, fights against all odds, obstacles, and problems with sheer determination and confidence.

Title: 870. Love Swindler
description: An anthology film of four stories that feature far more swindlers and swindling than lovers or love.

Title: 871. The Man from Nowhere
description: In 1860, a young orphaned girl is sent to live with her uncle, but she is troubled by a shadowy figure that appears and disappears.

Title: 872. As of Tomorrow
description: An ex-gangster retires to his native village in the Abruzzi mountains. He has kept some tapes which incriminate an American senator and his Mafia contacts. Various people try to get hold of the tapes - by fair means or foul.

Title: 873. The Garden of Stones
description: Darvish Khan a deaf and mute man who is a shepherd lives with his family in the desert. One day when sleeping in the desert he has a strange dream. When awake he finds a stone and carry it home and hangs it on a tree. Little by little he finds more stones carry them and hanging them on the trees until his garden of stones is becomes famous absorbing people from all around.

Title: 874. Ghazal
description: Two brothers Hojjat and Zein-Ala'bedin are the guards of the jungle and live alone by themselves. One day they are notice that some people are cutting the trees illegally. Hojjat chases them but returns home with a girl her name Ghazal. Zein-Ala'bedin falls in love with her but Hojjat too feels love for Ghazal. To avoid further problems they decide to get rid of the girl. They kill the girl and bury her body in the jungle and then burn their house and run away together.

Title: 875. The Double Crossers
description: Detective Lung is investigating the murder of his father and discovers his father belonged to a syndicate of smugglers. He finds out the murderer used to be his father's business partner and that he's now living in Hong Kong under a new name (Wang). Lung tries to lure Wang to Bali where he hopes to get his revenge.

Title: 876. Mimì Bluette... fiore del mio giardino
description: Mimi Bluette, daughter of a prostitute, lives in Paris where she is idolized by men of all kinds and classes. She is about to settle on a rich man when she meets a stranger in a bar.

Title: 877. Suntan
description: Dinanath (Ashok Kumar) is a labourer, who has determined to educate his son Kishore (Satyendra Kapoor) and make him a doctor and marry Kishore with his friend's Shanu (Indrani Mukherjee) as promised to his friend on the death-bed. Kishore promises to marry Shanu and makes her pregnant. But unfortunately, he has other plans of making quick money. Kishore marries Lata (Bindu) who is very rich and leaves his parents to utter neglect. Soon Shanu gives birth to a girl, while Geeta gives birth to a boy, Ravi (Jeetendra). Dinanath becomes blind his wife Tulsi (Nirupa Roy) works as a housemaid in her son's house only without giving her identity. Ravi grows up in her hands, develops lot of affection on Dinanath, Tulsi and Parvati. After 20 years Tulsi reveals the truth on her death bed, Kishore does not attend to her funeral, because of his status in the society and Dinanath also dies in car accident. Now Ravi decides to teach his parents a lesson for ill-treating his grandparents with the help of Advocate Baldev Raj (Utpal Dutt) and his daughter Sarita (Rekha).

Title: 879. H-Bomb
description: CIA agent Chris Mitchum is tasked with finding a terrorist who stole nuclear warheads and is hiding in Bangkok. The terrorist is the father of Mitchum's ex-girlfriend Olivia Hussey, complicating matters.

Title: 880. Demain les mômes
description: These brats have understood that grown-ups failed and they do not need them anymore.

Title: 881. Guardian of the Wilderness
description: Based on the life of Galen Clark, whose determined efforts led to the creation of Yosemite National Park. When he is diagnosed with terminal tuberculosis, and disappointed that he hasn't accomplished anything significant with his life, Clark decides to vanish into the California mountains to die. But after surviving a series of perilous misadventures, including a heartening encounter with famed explorer John Muir, he regains his spirit. Newly inspired, he launches a courageous battle against the aggressive lumber companies threatening to cut down the rare and precious forest of giant Sequoias. His fight to save the wilderness takes him first to Sacramento, and then Washington, D.C. where he convinces President Abraham Lincoln to declare Yosemite the first public land grant, paving the way for creation of the National Park System.

Title: 882. The Astrologer
description: Alexander is running a con game at a circus as a psychic. When he finds that he actually does possess psychic powers, he uses them for his own ends.

Title: 883. Blood and Passion
description: Pamplona (Spain), 1975: Dr. Navarro, a famous doctor in the city, feels strongly attracted to Juana, his nurse, who is also in love with the doctor. Navarro, however, moved by his strong religious convictions (in fact, he is a numerary member of Opus Dei) remains faithful to his wife and tries by all means to prevent that their relations with Juana break through professional boundaries. For the purpose of that, he orders the nurse will sent to another hospital. This will push Juana to take the initiative and provoke the doctor during San Fermines.

Title: 885. Rangilla Ratan
description: The first Indian adaptation of the film The Godfather was inspired from and loosely based on Ratan Khatri.

Title: 886. Let the Balloon Go
description: While his brother is fighting in WWI, a small independent Australian boy who lives in the countryside with his overbearing mother and pet dog and who must wear a leg brace decides to overcome his handicap no matter what.

Title: 887. Familien Gyldenkål sprænger banken
description: Now the family has reached the top step of the socially equitable, but unexpected demands from the tax administration mean that a forced sale is at the door. That is why they start the biggest plan yet: to defraud Fidusbanken.

Title: 888. One-Armed Swordsman vs. Nine Killers
description: Watch WANG YU as a one-armed savior battling the local goons in this martial arts classic. He has some rather amazing moves up his sleeve.

Title: 889. Philipp, der Kleine
description: A little boy wishes to be taller in order to be noticed by the others. Then he comes across a magical flute.

Title: 891. The Most Perverted Post War Crimes
description: There separate true life crimes reenacted showing the crimes being committed and the arrests. There is also a fictional TV show presenting before each case and talking briefly about other criminal cases.

Title: 892. I Am Self Sufficient
description: The film tells the misadventures of a company of players who are oppressed by a tyrannical director. At the same time, his friend Michele is living with the failure of his marriage to Silvia.

Title: 893. Mayura
description: The movie presents the story of a saintly boy who realises his royal connections and his return to his rightful place

Title: 894. Fountains of Lust
description: An Italian count travels to Greece and discovers a magical cave with water that enhances sexual vitality. The count engages in a flurry of activity, pleasing his wife, mistress, and a young hotel maid.

Title: 895. Joe Panther
description: A young Seminole Tribe member comes of age outside the Florida Everglades by trying to enter the establishment ( white man's world ). He gets work as crew member on (Brian Keith's) fishing boat, hunts for alligators and has cathartic encounters with bad guys trying to bring illegal immigrants into Florida on fishing boats.

Title: 896. Vergeet My Nie
description: Vergeet My Nie-(Forget me not) A small-town South African girl with dreams of living in the city spends the weekend with an old love in rural Namibia. While the pair reconnect, she begins to realize that country living isn't for her.

Title: 897. Juan que reía
description: A middle-class salesman and his wife struggle to improve their economic situation.

Title: 898. The Office Party
description: The misadventures of staff enjoying an office party.

Title: 899. Super Rider Against the Devils
description: A man is kidnapped by Doctor Death and given superpowers. But he escapes and meets another man, who also received superpowers. Together they create a team known as the "Super Riders" and battle the organization, fighting against the forces of Doctor Death, Ambassador Hell and more.

Title: 900. Older Brother, Younger Sister
description: Members of a country family react differently to the return of daughter Mon from a town factory.While the men are angry she is pregnant with no husband, the women show kindness.

Title: 901. Donna... cosa si fa per te
description: A rich Tuscan aristocrat is ensnared by a hooker looking for a better life.

Title: 902. King Kung Fu
description: A gorilla trained in martial arts gets loose and terrorizes the city of Wichita, Kansas.

Title: 903. Flaming Fire Chief
description: Brand-Børge is - bravely assisted by a couple of clever tanker drivers - messed up in a major crime affair, as horrible villains steal and smuggle in a precious diamond baked into a cake. Everyone is now wandering around and on their toes to find the missing diamond - among other things by eating their way through a sea of cakes.

Title: 904. Mädchen die am Wege liegen
description: The world of high society and beautiful girls, hallow parties, caviar, champagne, loaded with a high tension erotic atmosphere.

Title: 905. Jaaneman
description: A taxi-driver must unravel the mystery surrounding the woman he loves.

Title: 906. Burnt by a Scalding Passion
description: Virginia and Casimiro are both married with children to passionate spouses, while they are shy and devoted to poetry, crying watching "Anna Karenina" on TV. They commute every day from a little town in Lombardy to Milan and during the journeys they meet and fall in love. They suffer from being unable to realize their love without hurting their marriages but they don't know their respective spouses share a hot relationship...

Title: 907. Galpa Helebi Sata
description: Wealthy tourist at Temples of Konarak in Orissa meets and marries a local woman then leaves and doesn't return. His wife traces him to his home.

Title: 908. Vento, vento, portali via con te
description: Two policemen of the Narcotics Brigade, Nicola and Roberto, are unsuccessful at their job.

Title: 909. Big Bad Sis
description: Ah Ying is a former gangster trying to lead an honest life and occasionally using her fighting skills to help out the girls in the factory where she now works.

Title: 910. The Devil in the Heart
description: "The Devin in the Heart" takes place in a chic milieu, where both father and son are in love with the au pair girl. The young student is far from the post May 68 clichés and the movie walks a fine line off the beaten path.

Title: 911. The Widowhood of Karolina Zasler
description: The erotic relationship between Zhashler's wife Karolina and unknown young man is not welcomed by the residents of a small village, which makes the situation unbearable. When Zhashler kills himself, desperate Karolina starts changing men in order to find a compatriot who would give her warmth and lustful love.

Title: 912. Kolomba Sanniya
description: Andare is a poor village man who comes across a blue sapphire in the jungle. He sells it and becomes a millionaire and moves to Colombo with his family. Hilarious things happen when they try to adapt themselves to life in Colombo with modern amenities.

Title: 914. Three Person on line
description: Parvaneh meets the wealthy, idle Khosrow but falls for Mohammad. A jealous Khosrow harasses her, so Mohammad threatens to expose his drug deals. Their escalating conflict culminates in a tense road trip for the trio.

Title: 915. Woman in the Rain
description: A once-popular singer gives a candid interview, revealing the sordid details of her rags-to-riches-to-rags odyssey in the tawdry entertainment world.

Title: 916. Anthuleni Katha
description: The story of an elder sister trying to run a family devoid of father and a useless brother.

Title: 917. No toquen a la nena
description: A man becomes overprotective of his daughter as a friend of his son comes to live at the family home.

Title: 918. Passi furtivi in una notte boia
919. Dying
description: Last days: Sally, 46, bonds with her elderly mother as they take things day to day; Bill, 30s, stoically goes on while his wife loses herself in rage; grandfatherly Reverend Bryant preaches a final sermon, then returns South one last time.

Title: 920. Moi, Tintin
description: A documentary about herge and his experience writing the tin tin comics.

Title: 921. Sven Klangs kvintett
description: Sweden 1958. In a small provincial town there is a band who plays dance music twice every week. All decisions are made by Sven Klang, the undisputed leader of the band. A new member joins them, saxophone player Lasse. He starts to criticize Sven's decisions, questions the way they divide the money and he also wants them to be more of a jazz band.

Title: 922. Perché si uccidono (La merde)
description: Andrea has big existential problems, and like many young people he thinks he can solve them with drugs. His girlfriend, less experienced than him, takes a strong dose and dies.

Title: 923. Zoku ningen kakumei
description: In the second part of a biographical story, a man is released from jail and forges ahead with the business of religion. Then one day he meets a nineteen-year-old who asks him many questions and reminds him of his own younger days. The younger man converts to the older man's religion. His business finds followers, but there is not enough passion or curiosity amidst the followers. A problem arises soon. A female follower wants to divorce her yakuza husband and things become rough.

Title: 924. Erotika zevgaria
description: A Greek couple meets a couple of vacationers from abroad and they exchange love partners.

Title: 925. Agar bargi narizad
description: After her husband's death, Fereshte lives with her daughter and son, struggling to raise them alone. But her daughter becomes ill and she needs to hospitalize her with help from their neighbor Tal'at. She spends the night in the hospital by her daughter's bedside, but in the morning the doctors tell her that it's too late, they can do nothing more; maybe if no leaf falls, her daughter will recover. The son begins to gather and carry leaves, crying as he pastes them on the trees. Will this work? What if it doesn't?

Title: 926. Comment Yukong déplaça les montagnes
description: From 1972 until 1974, Joris Ivens and Marceline Loridan, along with a Chinese film crew, documented the last days of the Cultural Revolution, marking the end of an era. The vast amount of footage they shot was edited into twelve films of varying lengths. Focusing on ordinary people spread over a wide geographic area-many of whom were living and working in collectives-the filmmakers recorded a unique moment in history, and also captured some of the more enduring aspects of Chinese culture.

Title: 927. Rakshaa Bandhan
description: Madhav and Pravati rescue snake goddess, blessed with daughter Asha raised by relatives. Asha's marriage opposed, goddess sends snake to help. Goddess intervenes when Asha's fiancé Amar endangered.

Title: 928. El rey
description: During Mexico's Revolution, guerrilla fighters abduct two people from a ruling family and seek ransom payment.

Title: 929. Un amore targato Forlì
description: The young cellist Stefano from the province seeks success in Rome, trying to be recommended by the impresario Melchiorri for a place at the Opera House. The failures multiply, until Stefano, increasingly disillusioned by a narrow and ignorant society, by the same idle Melchiorri, and by his girlfriend Giorgia who betrays him, decides to return home.

Title: 930. Simbad, O Marujo Trapalhão
description: Kiko and Duda, circus workers, get into a big mess when Kiko is mistaken for the trampist Sinbad. The bumbling boy is then abducted by the minions of the magician Ali Tuffi, who already has in his power the genius of the magic bottle, but they need the trapeze artist, descendant of the true sailor, to locate the philosopher's stone with which he will become a man very rich, with lots of fortune and power. In an attempt to help his friends, the real trampist Simbad and his girlfriend Luciana also end up being held prisoner on the bandits' ship. After a confusion, everyone will stop on an island full of dangers, where the stone is hidden.

Title: 931. Bad Barbara
description: Young woman baby-sits for the special needs an adult brother of family patriarch, but things get out of hand quick when husband and wife are swingers, and that fact is the least of their wacky, fetishistic traits.

Title: 932. Bør Børson II
description: In Olderdalen Bør Børson has affirmed his stand as the king of the valley and the richest man with the biggest house.

Title: 933. Blood and Bullets
description: Dan Caputo arrives at New York to avenge the death of his father, an ex-cop who was involved in mob business.

Title: 934. The Young Dracula
description: Dracula's descendants leave the property to Mina in a will. But that was not what was planned by Count Dracula, who intended to continue his legacy in his great-grandson Jonathan Dracula.

Title: 935. Madol Duwa
description: The adventure of a rebellious child, running away from his house to an island called Madol Duwa.

Title: 936. Shao Lin zu shi
description: A female martial-arts fighter goes up against an evil Shao-Lin priest who has aligned himself with the Devil.

Title: 937. Redhead
description: During the summer of 1944 a Romanian orphaned teenager is coping with the pain of being alone,hungry,homeless and harassed by the police and is suffering the rigors of detention in a juvenile correctional institution.

Title: 938. Caro Michele
description: Michele is the younger son of a middle-class family, a strong-willed and free-thinking fellow who is off in some distant country fighting for a revolutionary cause.

Title: 939. Ninkyô gaiden: Genkai nada
description: A Yakuza smuggler gets involved with a Korean prostitute.

Title: 942. Kadin Hamlet
description: Adaptation of Hamlet, whose father was murdered. But in this story, Hamlet is a woman.

Title: 943. The Grim Reaper
description: A mother is worried about her husband and her older son, who no longer go to church and begin to communicate with dead spirits. Worst of all, the son wants to be a stock-car racer.

Title: 944. Öyle Olsun
description: Ferit who works as a reporter on a newspaper, makes fake news about the olive oil king Hulusi. One day he writes that he adds machine oils to his oils, another day he writes that his daughter Alev hangs up with men and prints her photos. Actually the married man seen in the photos is Alev's cousin.

Title: 945. Stangata in famiglia
description: Brambilla discovers that all the members of his family are connected to an organization dedicated to prostitution.

Title: 946. La nipote del prete
description: Desirée, a Swedish girl who's the niece of a priest, comes to Ancona. Uninhibited and a naturist, she attracts the attention of boys and dislikes of local women.

Title: 947. Ananda Mela
description: A person leaves everything for his love .

Title: 948. Diary of a Surfing Film
description: A young surfer making a surfing film travels through French Heat, South African Blowout, California Cream and Hawaiian Perfection.

Title: 949. The Peaks of Zelengora
description: During the Battle of Sutjeska, partisan troops must endure 24 hours of big and heavy attacks on German units Ljubino grave, to the main Partisan units, with the wounded and the Supreme Headquarters, pulled out the ring that is tightened around them.

Title: 952. Ballagó idö
description: The adolescent Pisti, spends his summer vacation with his parents and grandmother in a small village. He has a vivid imagination: through old objects found in the attic, conversations of animals, and stories told by his grandmother and his neighbor, the history of his family comes to life, even the world of the betyárs. While committing mischief, Pisti also begins to see the realities of life. He tastes wine and smokes cigarettes for the first time, sees what living with old age and death is like, and also finds his first love.

Title: 954. Happy Day
description: The film depicts the penal experience of political prisoners exiled to a small Aegean island during the military junta and in particular one prisoner's refusal to submit.

Title: 955. Shankar Shambhu
description: Inspector Ranjit Singh lives a middle-classed lifestyle along with his wife, Laxmi, a son, Pappu, and daughter, Pinky. When the National Bank is broken into one night, he gives chase to the robbers, and shoots one of them dead. The dead robber's brother, Kundan, manages to get away with the loot, then tracks down Ranjit and his family, shoots at them, forcing their jeep to fall into the Narbada river, separating the entire family. Ranjit manages to rescue Laxmi, and then apprehends Kundan, has him tried in Court, and sentenced to jail for several years, but is unable to recover the stolen loot. Years later, Kundan gets discharged and is received by his nephew, Chaman. Ranjit is now the Inspector General of Police, and Laxmi still hopes to be reunited with her children. Pappu has been adopted by a bandit named Lakhan Singh, who re-names him Shambhu, and brings him up with his other son, Shankar. Pinky has been adopted by a widow, who has re-named her Sulakshana, who makes a living as a petty thief. Shankar and Shambhu, on the run from the Police, end up in Bombay, where they will be thrust into conflict with Kundan and Chaman on one hand, and Ranjit Singh on the other.

Title: 956. La menor
description: A teenage girl, the daughter of a Brazilian businessman, travels to Spain with her parents. Her mother has forced her husband to change country because he has a mistress. The girl is assaulted and raped by a group of young men, led by a young delinquent who holds up petrol stations.

Title: 957. Fighting Black Kings
description: This documentary follows the training regimen of fighters from all over the world as they prepare for the prestigious all-world full contact karate tournament in Japan.

Title: 958. Tiger Man
description: A child and his mother are forced to run away after thugs kill the father and burn down their house. They go to his uncle house where he learns kung-fu and eventually moves to the USA as an adult.

Title: 960. The Web of Death
description: Members of a martial arts clan, who possesses a powerful magical weapon, scheme to use the unstoppable weapon to rule the martial arts world. Only the clan leader and his daughter stand in their way.

Title: 961. Aaj Ka Mahaatma
description: Randhir and Ranvir Verma are twins. Randhir is straightforward, while Ranvir is a petty criminal. These petty thefts add up, and soon the police arrest Ranvir, and he is sentenced to prison. In prison, Ranvir incurs the wrath of a gangster, Tony, and is killed. Randhir undertakes to find the killer, and gets himself arrested, and imprisoned to get to see who the killer is. After getting out from prison, Randhir plans to avenge his brother's death, without knowing that he himself could endanger his very life, as well the life of his girlfriend, Mala. The song "Chandni chand se hoti hai, sitaron se nahin, pyar bhi ek se hota hai hazaron se nahin..." is still popular.

Title: 962. Bundal Baaz
description: Daydreamer Rajaram lives a poor lifestyle in a village in India along with his aunt and an unmarried sister, Malti, who has mortgaged their shanty house with Sukhi Lala so that she can educate Rajaram in Bombay. Rajaram pretends to be wealthy in order to get married to his sweetheart, Nisha Sharma, much to the chagrin of her dad who wants her to get married to a boxer, Ranjeet Gupta. After Rajaram gets a degree in Arts he returns home and finds out about the debt, he attempts to find work, ends up working as a laborer with Sukhi, but is beaten-up when he is found slacking. Rajaram returns to Bombay, meets with Suleiman, and takes up collecting waste material (Dabha Batli) from households for a fee. One day he comes across a bottle, which falls down and out pops a 20000 year old Genie with magical powers. Rajaram does not want anything to do with this Genie, who insists on helping him for one year regardless. With his help Rajaram and Suleiman improve their lifestyle, albeit with a lot of problems, and also improve Rajaram's chances of getting married to Nisha. Things get complicated when the Genie loses his ring, which ends up with Ranjeet, who summons another Genie, Jumjumbo, from the very pits of hell, and abducts Nisha and her dad in order to force Nisha to marry him. Rajaram and the Genie set out for their rescue - only to find that the Genie has no powers underground - and both end up at the mercy of the evil Jumjumbo and Ranjeet.

Title: 963. Super Dragon
description: A wealthy merchant hires the services of several top martial artists to escort a consignment of treasure out of the province The escort is constantly attacked and finally the mission is brought to an abrupt halt when a masked fighter wants to expose a heinous plot.

Title: 965. Vojnikova ljubav
description: Young Belgrade playboy, spoiled child of a rich family, changes for the better after spending some time in the army.

Title: 966. The War of the 16 Year Olds
description: A young drifter and a precocious girl of sixteen slowly form a bond in a small town haunted by its wartime past.

Title: 967. De todos modos Juan te llamas
description: El movimiento cristero, durante la Guerra Cristera en 1926 en Mexico.

Title: 968. Bitayin si... Baby Ama!
description: Depicting the life of executed gang leader and murderer Marciál "Baby" Ama.

Title: 969. Second Wind
description: A successful executive and family man takes up jogging for a hobby. Soon his desire to excel as a long distance runner interferes with his career and marriage.

Title: 970. Imposible para una solterona
description: At 35 years old and despite having a good job as a secretary, Gina Alonso is still single, perhaps because she suffers from a serious overweight problem. When her boyfriend leaves her, a period full of sadness and monotony begins for Gina. However, everything suddenly changes when she meets a very attractive young doctor, but whose intentions are not very clear.

Title: 971. Songs for After a War
description: This documentary is frame in the spanish hyper realism. A journey through the legendary songs of Franco dictatorship. With the colaboration of the wonderful singer Imperio Argentina.

Title: 972. Zacazonapan
description: Three married friends compete against each other to see who has the first child.

Title: 973. The Written Off Return
description: Prle and Tihi, being the only surviving members of their resistance group, had been forced to leave Nazi-occupied Belgrade and join Partisans in country. In Summer of 1944 somebody is assassinating resistance sympathizers, and Prle and Tihi must return to Belgrade deal with it. In order to cross through enemy lines, they use cars, clothes and documents of captured pro-Nazi minister. During their journey the minister escapes and warns the Gestapo.

Title: 974. Sangram
description: Separated as children, two brothers end up on opposite sides of the law. When their paths cross during a heist, they form an alliance unaware of their true connection.

Title: 975. Gülsah: Küçük Anne
description: Gülsah is the happy child of Nurten and Murat couple. Nurten gives birth to her second child. However, the birth of the baby marks the beginning of the end for them.

Title: 976. The Longest Journey
description: March 1903. The Ottoman Empire is in a process of disintegration. Only Macedonia is not still liberated in the Balkans. The Macedonian revolutionary movement is in full growth. The Turks are trying to keep their last bastion in Europe. The Macedonian people are being exposed to the most severe oppressions as it is due to the revenge of the Turks for supporting and protecting the komitas - Macedonian freedom-fighters. In such a case the Turks besiege a village where a weeding ceremony is taking place. They shoot at the peasants, round them up and most of them are being taken away. More than two hundred people are taken prisoner in the fortress. The Turks sentence them to from 15 to 101 years in prison. Then the prisoners are loaded on a ship and are transported to Asia Minor. On their way through the desert the Macedonians are exposed to various humiliations. A lot of them overeat and die. In October 1908, the prisoners arrive at the place where they are to serve the sentence.

Title: 977. Ek Se Badhkar Ek
description: Story of two young brothers estranged during a situational criminal act leading to their long separation. Shankar grows up to be a local thief who spent his childhood in search of his elder brother while having befriended a ranked police officer, Rajesh and his mother, whom he adores. Rajesh's fiancé, Rekha loses her mother in an accident which coincidentally leads to the mysterious return of her estranged father. Their lives intertwine when an archeological discovery of a 5000 year old diamond brings them all together in several attempts leading to the deceitful theft of the diamond and eventually leading to the union of a family.

Title: 978. Il bocconcino
description: Young Gigi, a teenager, is enjoying Summer vacation with uncle Amedeo and his wife. He seduces his cousin, Gemma and a his English teacher, Betsy, a blond girl.

Title: 979. Mysteries of the Gods
description: A documentary movie about the influence of "ancient astronauts" in mankind's history.

Title: 980. La spirale
description: Based on movie and television archives, this film aims to demonstrate how the United States planned to crush Salvador Allende's attempt to institute Socialism in Chili, shortly after his election.

Title: 981. Já Não Se Faz Amor Como Antigamente
description: Film in three segments. In the first, father is suspicious about his son's masculinity. The second one shows a Don Juan-like guy who, at church for his own wedding, cannot remember who the bride might be. In the third, a rich husband tries to find the tattooed man he saw escaping through his wife's bedroom window.

Title: 982. Andô Noboru no waga tôbô to Sex no kiroku
description: Ando on the run, stopping in to service all the women in his life, with a bit of the old ultra-violence.

Title: 983. La croisée des chemins
description: The peregrinations of a group of boys and girls from Paris. Two girls swap the capital for the countryside near Montpellier. One of the girls hesitates between dream world and reality.La croisée des chemins marks the start of a significant oeuvre and is a film in which reality and dream are mixed. Jean-Claude Brisseau shot this film on Super8 in 1975. Screened in Studio 43 in Paris, the film was noticed and admired by Eric Rohmer, who attached the name of his production company Les Films du Losange to several films by Brisseau: Un jeu brutal, De bruit et de fureur en Noce blanche.

Title: 984. Taksi Soförü
description: Mehmet and Sibel, who love each other. Mehmet's boss and friend Ibrahim will inherit a great fortune. Ibrahim, who suddenly started to lead a rich life, confesses his love to Sibel, which he has been hiding for years.

Title: 985. A Sold Life
description: A Life Sold (1976). Two friends fight against fascism in Europe.

Title: 986. Al piacere di rivederla
description: The head of the Bonfiglio family, a great industrialist, dies by suicide. Since there are big deals involved, the ministry sends a commissioner to investigate. It turns out that all members of the Bonfiglio family are corrupt.

Title: 987. El secreto inconfesable de un chico bien
description: A young man from a wealthy family, the son of a strict arms caretaker at the service of the regime, keeps a terrible secret: he is impotent.

Title: 988. Shag navstrechu
description: The film contains five short stories, united by the story of the incipient love of two middle-aged people who meet every day on the way to work. Meeting every day on public transport, they do not even suspect that they are housemates, and constantly cause each other a lot of trouble. Five short stories: "The Captain's Daughter", "Father Seraphim", "Argentinean Meat", "Wedding March", "For Only 30 Kopecks" - lyrical stories about these events.

Title: 989. Protect and Survive
description: Protect and Survive was a public information series on civil defence produced by the British government during the late 1970s and early 1980s. It was intended to inform British citizens on how to protect themselves during a nuclear attack, and consisted of a mixture of pamphlets, radio broadcasts, and public information films. The series had originally been intended for distribution only in the event of dire national emergency, but provoked such intense public interest that the pamphlets were authorised for general release.

Title: 990. Kassen stemmer
description: When a member of the better Aarhus bourgeoisie is threatened with bankruptcy, his two friends rush to his rescue. They devise an inventive financial scam - but three young men overhear the plan and immediately steal it. As a burnt out journalist also gets entangled in the affair, the outcome becomes impossible to predict.

Title: 991. Speeding Naked Till High Noon
description: A young man who has killed his creditor is coerced into cutting his ties with his fiancé and marrying the woman who witnessed his crime.

Title: 992. Play-Boy
description: Roopesh, a millionaire's son turned playboy, squanders away his father's wealth on wine, women, and gambling in far off Malaysia and Singapore. Roopesh learns his parents have been killed in a plane crash and hurries home only to find that his father's will states that, in order to inherit the family property, Roopesh must settle down and marry an Indian girl, and so he takes on a marriage of convenience with Geeta, the estate manager's daughter. When Roopesh is summoned back to the far east, due to a blackmail scheme against him, Geeta sends her friend Shital to keep an eye on him. But Shital plays on Roopesh's weakness for women and makes him fall for her. Unbeknownst to him, Shital is working hand in hand with those who are blackmailing him.

Title: 993. The Moon Over the Alley
description: The Moon Over the Alley reunited Duffer writer/directors Joseph Despins and William Dumaresq, with this strange London-set musical, again scored by Galt MacDermont (Hair). The film explores the problems facing the multicultural residents in a Notting Hill boarding house of the early 1970s, destined for demolition. Dark and disturbing, yet also dreamlike and tender, this astonishing film defies all categorisation. This title is also available on DVD / Blu-ray in the BFI's Flipside collection.

Title: 994. A Butterfly in the Night
description: A street whore in Paris is taken home to her native Argentina by an in love rich landlord.

Title: 995. Das Schweigen im Walde
description: Earl Ellinger leads a dissolute life in Munich's high-society, far away from his estates, where he ruinously exploits the forests to finance his expensive way of life. Only when he flees from his aggressive fiancée, baroness Elena, into the lonesome mountains, he learns about the consequences of his doings from the beautiful dairymaid Lore.

Title: 996. Let's Talk About Love
description: A television host tries to react to the process of alienation that the public is subjected to from variety shows.

Title: 997. Voyage to the Edge of the World
description: On his ship "Calypso," as well as in a submarine, Jacques Cousteau and his crew sail from South America and travel to Antarctica. They explore islands, reefs, icebergs, fossils, active volcanic craters, and creatures of the ocean never before seen. This voyage took place in 1975, and Captain Cousteau became one of the first explorers ever to dive beneath the waters of the frozen South Pole.

Title: 998. Return of the 18 Bronzemen
description: The reigning Qing Emperor dies and his fourth son changes his father's will to his favor and becomes the new emperor. He disguises himself as a commoner, and becomes a disciple in the Shaolin Temple in order to become a kung fu master.

Title: 999. The Eight Masters
description: Rescued from his house as a child and sent to the Shaolin Temple, Chu Shiao Chieh learns the martial arts and the virtues of patience and mercy. Upon reaching manhood, Chu sets out to reunite with his blind mother and cousin. His refusal to involve himself in fighting injustices is challenged when the Eight Masters kidnap his mother as revenge for his father's misdeeds.
